jobs.title: VP of Growth| Poppy & Peonies
jobs.excerpt: Bloom is a full-service workplace design consultancy, proudly supporting Poppy & Peonies in their search for a VP of Growth to join their dynamic team.
jobs.description:
Bloom is a full-service workplace design consultancy, proudly supporting Poppy & Peonies in their search for a VP of Growth to join their dynamic team. As Talent Advisors, we serve as the bridge between our Bloom Partner and you throughout the recruitment process. At Bloom, we don’t rely on automated tools to sift through applications—every resume is carefully reviewed by a real person to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. If selected, you’ll join Poppy & Peonies directly as a valued member of their team. We’re excited to consider your application! Please note that applications will be accepted throughout the holiday season. Thank you for your patience and interest in this opportunity.

Hi, I’m Natalie Dusome, Founder and CEO of Poppy & Peonies, a fun and energetic brand that believes styles and function should co-exist. We’re passionate about creating practical pieces that help make life a little easier and lighten the load, literally.

Building Poppy & Peonies has been a wild adventure. The journey began when my daughter Poppy was born, and my accessories no longer worked with my new life as a mom; I needed bags with pockets and organization that looked cool and had functionality. I couldn’t find it, so I decided to create it, and in 2015 Poppy & Peonies was born.

We’ve come a long way in five years – from filling orders in my basement to appearing on Dragons’ Den, and now, expanding into new product categories and collaborating with some exciting influencers and brands. I’d be lying if I said it’s been nothing but smooth sailing, but thanks to our incredible community, we’ve never felt more loved and supported!

We believe in our responsibility to care for our environment, and we are passionate about preserving the health and welfare of our planet and the animals that live on it. All of our bags are made from high-quality vegan leather, and our entire product line is vegan, cruelty-free, and PETA-approved. We ship our products plastic-free, and we use a combination of recycled, compostable, and biodegradable materials to mitigate shipping waste. We are constantly looking for new ways to make our products and supply chain more sustainable to reduce our carbon footprint.

About the Role:

We are seeking a strategic, execution-savvy VP of Growth to own the full customer lifecycle, from first touch to retained, repeat customer. This is a senior leadership role responsible for setting the growth agenda for the business and building the team and infrastructure to execute against it.

As VP of Growth, you'll lead a team spanning new customer acquisition, ecommerce and retention, with Director of Retention and Director of Ecommerce reporting directly to you, alongside ownership of TikTok Shop and all new customer acquisition channels. You'll be the senior leader accountable for how the business grows, both in bringing in new customers and in keeping and growing the value of customers once they're in the fold. You'll report to the Co-founder and represent growth as a core pillar in company-wide strategy and investment decisions.

This leader will partner closely with executive leadership to drive growth, inspire cross-functional collaboration, and build a high-performing marketing team.

The Opportunity:

    Growth Strategy & Team Leadership:• Set the overall growth strategy for the business, spanning acquisition, ecommerce, and retention as one connected system rather than siloed functions
    • Directly manage and develop the Director of Retention and Director of Ecommerce, setting goals, coaching performance, and ensuring alignment across their teams
    • Own the growth org structure, headcount planning, and team build-out as the function scales
    • Build a culture of accountability, experimentation, and cross-functional collaboration across the growth organization
    • Represent growth in executive and board-level discussions, bringing a clear point of view on where to invest and why

    New Customer Acquisition:• Own the end-to-end new customer acquisition strategy across all channels, paid, owned, earned, and emerging
    • Own and evolve paid digital marketing strategy across Meta, TikTok, Google, Pinterest, and other paid channels
    • Own and lead relationships with paid media agencies and other external acquisition partners
    • Lead the launch and ongoing scaling of TikTok Shop as an acquisition and commerce channel
    • Build and grow an affiliate program and other emerging acquisition channels (creator partnerships, social commerce, marketplaces)
    • Own key acquisition metrics (CAC, ROAS, MER, new customer growth) and be accountable for acquisition efficiency and scale

    Ecommerce:• Partner closely with and oversee the Director of Ecommerce to ensure the site experience, merchandising, and conversion strategy support both acquisition and retention goals

    • Ensure ecommerce roadmap priorities (site experience, checkout, merchandising, platform investments) are aligned with broader growth strategy
    • Use ecommerce performance data (conversion rate, AOV, site funnel behaviour) to inform acquisition and retention decisions

    Retention & Customer Lifecycle:
    • Partner closely with and oversee the Director of Retention to ensure post-purchase, lifecycle, and loyalty strategies are built to maximize customer LTV
    • Ensure retention strategy is informed by acquisition channel data, connecting who you acquire to how they're retained
    • Own the connective tissue between acquisition and retention, ensuring the business optimizes for lifetime value, not just first-purchase economics
    • Set company-wide LTV and repeat purchase rate goals in partnership with the Director of Retention

What You Bring to the Table

    •15+ years of experience in growth and P&L ownership
    • Proven track record leading full-funnel growth (acquisition through retention) within a direct-to-consumer, retail, fashion, or lifestyle brand
    • Experience managing a team through directors or senior managers, ideally with direct oversight of both acquisition and retention or ecommerce functions
    • Deep expertise across paid social, paid search, media buying, and performance marketing strategy
    • Direct experience launching or scaling TikTok Shop and/or affiliate programs as acquisition channels
    • Strong understanding of ecommerce fundamentals (conversion optimization, merchandising, site experience) and retention/lifecycle strategy (LTV, repeat purchase rate, loyalty, email/SMS)
    • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to connect data across acquisition, ecommerce, and retention into unified business decisions
    • Track record of scaling revenue through data-driven strategy across the full customer lifecycle
    • Experience managing agencies, freelancers, and external partners at a senior level
    • Executive presence and strong communication skills, comfortable representing growth strategy to senior leadership and the board
    • Comfortable balancing high-level strategy with hands-on involvement when a new channel or initiative needs direct leadership to get off the ground
    • Genuine interest in fashion, lifestyle, and community-driven brands

The recruitment process

  • Video screen with Talent Advisor from Bloom
  • Video Interview with Natalie Dusome, Founder + CEO of Poppy & Peonies
  • Second Video Interview with Steph, VP Operations & Natalie, VP Finance
  • Reference checks
  • Offer
    • Applications will be accepted through mid-September. Candidates can expect to hear from us regarding next steps by September 8th, 2026.

Location

  • We’re seeking an exceptional candidate based in the US or Canada who values the flexibility of remote work while embracing the excitement of in-person experiences.
  • There will be occasional domestic and/or international travel for photoshoots, events, and team retreats.

Salary and Total Rewards

  • Annual Salary ranges from $225,000-$275,000
  • Performance bonus
  • 4 weeks of paid vacation per year
  • Health benefits coverage
  • $250 annual period & menstrual budget
  • $1,000 annual allowance towards Poppy & Peonies product
  • $400 home office setup allowance
    • All compensation and benefit amounts are reflected in local currency (CAD/USD where applicable).
    At Bloom, we see conversations around compensation as a continuous discussion. We encourage you to share your desired compensation early in the interview process, but we also understand that as you learn more about the role and the full benefits package, your expectations might evolve. Don't worry - there will be plenty of opportunities throughout the process to revisit and adjust those conversations if needed.

Our Commitment to you.

Like Bloom, Poppy & Peonies is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equitable employment practices and do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status.We’re looking for motivated, compassionate people who are excited to contribute, grow with the team, and support the values that Poppy & Peonies believes in.Poppy & Peonies is committed to developing an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. Please inform us if you require any accommodation, and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs. Requests for any accessibility-related assistance can be made to

believe transparency matters, especially as technology evolves.

At Bloom, we may leverage AI as a supportive tool when developing role descriptions, interview questions, take home assignments, and interview guides, where appropriate, with the goal of improving clarity, consistency, and accessibility for candidates. However, we do not use AI to source, assess, screen, or interview candidates. Every application is reviewed by a human, every interview is conducted by a human, and all hiring decisions are made by people, not automated systems. Human judgment, care, and accountability are central to how we hire.

About Bloom

Bloom is a full-service workplace design consultancy representing Poppy & Peonies at they build their team. As Talent Advisors, we will be the liaison between our Bloom Partner and yourself during this recruitment process. We do not use fancy tech to search through resumes at Bloom; every resume is reviewed by a human to ensure that we attain a consistent and equitable interview process. You will directly join our client’s team if you are selected as the successful candidate. We look forward to seeing your application!

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleIf you've worked with Student Information Systems and are passionate about helping institutions modernize the student experience, The Student First partnership is expanding Blackbaud’s Higher Education strategy and we're looking for a Senior Solutions Consultant with deep Student Information System (SIS) expertise to help shape how colleges and universities evaluate modern SIS, Financial Aid, Student Accounts, payment processing, and connected campus solutions.
jobs.description:
About the Role

If you've worked with Student Information Systems and are passionate about helping institutions modernize the student experience, The Student First partnership is expanding Blackbaud’s Higher Education strategy and we're looking for a Senior Solutions Consultant with deep Student Information System (SIS) expertise to help shape how colleges and universities evaluate modern SIS, Financial Aid, Student Accounts, payment processing, and connected campus solutions. Together, Blackbaud and Student First will deliver a best-in-class Connected Campus experience that reduces complexity and campus silos, unifying enrollment, financial aid, scholarships, advancement and finance into a single operating model. You'll play a key role in building our SIS practice while helping institutions solve some of their most complex operational challenges. As a Senior Solutions Consultant, you'll combine your Higher Education expertise with consultative problem-solving to help colleges and universities evaluate and modernize the technology that powers the student lifecycle. Working closely with Sales, you'll guide institutions through discovery, validation, and solution evaluation while helping them understand how modern technology, automation, payments, and emerging AI capabilities can support institutional goals and improve student outcomes. You'll be one of our first dedicated SIS specialists, helping shape how we support Higher Education institutions, validate complex solutions, and scale our go-to-market strategy. You'll have the opportunity to influence best practices, enablement, customer experiences, and the future of Higher Education Solutions Consulting at Blackbaud.

What You'll Do

  • Lead discovery conversations with stakeholders across admissions, enrollment, registrar operations, Financial Aid, Student Accounts, IT, and executive leadership.
  • Design and lead validation experiences that help institutions evaluate business, operational, and technical fit.
  • Deliver compelling demonstrations, workshops, and proof scenarios aligned to customer priorities.
  • Advise customers on SIS modernization, process improvement, payment processing, integrations, reporting, and change management.
  • Help customers understand how automation and emerging AI capabilities can support institutional effectiveness.
  • Support RFPs, technical evaluations, proof-of-concept activities, and executive presentations.
  • Partner closely with Student First and internal Blackbaud teams to deliver successful customer outcomes.
  • Create reusable demo experience assets, enablement resources, and best practices that help scale Blackbaud's SIS expertise.

What You’ll Have

  • 5+ years of Higher Education SIS experience.
  • Strong understanding of admissions, enrollment, registration, academic records, and student services.
  • Experience working within Higher Education or supporting Higher Education technology solutions.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and consultative problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to build credibility with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25%.
  • Experience with student finance, billing, and payment processes.
  • Experience with SIS platforms such as Banner, Colleague, Workday Student, PeopleSoft, Anthology Student, or Jenzabar.
  • Experience in consulting, implementation, solutions consulting, or sales engineering.
  • Familiarity with AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives in Higher Education.
  • Familiarity with Blackbaud solutions, including Raiser's Edge NXT, Financial Edge NXT, and Blackbaud Integrated Payments.

Stay up to date on everything Blackbaud, follow us on Linkedin, Twitter, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube ​

Blackbaud powers social impact through purpose‑driven technology and responsible AI. Guided by our Intelligence for Good® vision, we’re building a culture where innovation, trust, and human expertise come together to help organizations make a greater difference in the world.

Blackbaud is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, or veteran status or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

The starting base salary and annual proposed commission is $98,400.00 to $127,000.00. Blackbaud may pay more or less based on employee qualifications, market value, sales quota, Company finances, and other operational considerations.

Benefits Include:

  • Wellness Programs

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Generous Parental Leave

  • Donations for Doers

  • Pet insurance, legal and identity protection

  • Tuition reimbursement program

jobs.description:
Working with us

We provide you with a working environment where personal development and value creation go hand in hand. You will gain access to our learning materials to improve your financial skills which will come in handy during future interviews. You provide extensive coverage of Mergers, Acquisitions, and major corporate transactions and lead the team to excel in research. You will dive into the deal announcement, proxies, earnings calls, and more. You will identify and outline the rationale of both the buyer and seller, underlying trends, market and product opportunities, and key industry consequences of the deals. You will interact and build relationships with like-minded students from across the globe. You will build a strong, performance-oriented team environment and informally coach the incoming analysts. You will help Focus Finance drive international engagement and build the brand. And if you are committed, more challenging projects and positions are in for you.

Your key responsibilities

  • Conduct research and financial reports writing together with the report team, ensuring execution quality and alignment to Focus Finance’s quality standards

  • Liaise with the M&A Global Heads and Leadership Team for strategic and operational division decision-making

  • Participate in the learning schemes and seek to develop your finance knowledge, as well as benefit from practical learning in team and project management

  • Help Focus Finance drive engagement, gain new readership and expand its brand presence at new universities

We carefully recruit all our members to ensure consistency across our branches. We are looking at a number of skills and interests throughout the recruitment process:

  • Undergraduate student specializing in finance, management, economics, engineering, or similar (we welcome applications from all universities across the globe)

  • Knowledge on how to construct valuation models from scratch (3-statement operating model, DCF, trading comps)

  • High industry, business and commercial awareness

  • A strong interest in M&A, capital markets, private equity or corporate development

  • Previous leadership/management experience is a plus but not required

  • Core soft skills – teamwork, adaptability, resilience, international mindset

  • The ability to balance qualitative and quantitative data

You may submit your CV (a cover letter is not required for this position). A member of the Human Capital Management team will screen your application and inform you regarding the next steps.

Do you have questions regarding this job opening? For more information, please contact Rayan Singh (Co-Head of M&A) or the Human Capital Management team via the Contact function on our website (www.focusfinance.org/contact)

Focus Finance provides equal opportunities for all members and applicants for employment. It prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.

We are Focus Finance, a global network of students interested in finance & banking. Our analysts and partners work across 5 report streams (M&A Deals, Industry Trends, Capital Markets, Equity Research and Global M&A Outlook) to deliver high-quality and rich content reports to our readership and institutional partners. We bring together 90+ passionate, motivated and determined students from 35 universities across 12 countries to provide a truly international platform for career development and networking. We are active, self-managed and always looking for new challenges.

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are: HelioCampus was founded with the purpose of helping college & university leaders navigate today’s growing pressures.
jobs.description:
Who We Are: HelioCampus was founded with the purpose of helping college & university leaders navigate today’s growing pressures. As one of EdTech’s most steadily growing companies, our roots in higher ed ground us in the critical nature of this work.

What We Do:We help our clients navigate today’s high stakes with data and Institutional Performance Management practices. Together with our clients, we chart a path to sustainability by borrowing practices from the most successful businesses.

How We Do It:
We approach our work with a “we’re on it” attitude that the higher ed community has come to know and expect from our team. We’re data geeks to our core, committed to simplifying the toughest challenges and operating with transparency. Our most successful team members are change agents who love a challenge.

How You'll Help:The VP of Client Success will be responsible for leading and managing the client success team to ensure the successful adoption, retention, and expansion of our company's products and services by our clients. You will play a crucial role in building strong relationships with clients, understanding their needs, and working cross-functionally to drive customer satisfaction and long-term success. This position requires a strategic mindset, exceptional leadership skills, and a deep understanding of customer success principles.

What You Will Do:

  • Team Leadership:

    • Lead, mentor, and motivate the client success team, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

    • Set clear performance expectations, objectives, and key results (OKRs) for team members, regularly assessing and providing feedback on their performance.

    • Ensure the team is equipped with the necessary tools, resources, and training to deliver outstanding customer experiences.

  • Customer Success Strategy:

    • Develop and implement a comprehensive customer success strategy that drives impact for clients and aligns with the company's overall goals and objectives.

    • Identify opportunities to improve customer satisfaction, retention, and expansion by analyzing customer data, trends, and feedback.

  • Client Relationship Management:

    • Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, acting as their advocate within the company and ensuring their needs are met.

    • Proactively engage with clients to understand their business objectives, challenges, and opportunities, providing strategic guidance and support.

  • Customer Onboarding and Adoption:

    • Oversee the onboarding process for new clients, ensuring a smooth and efficient transition to using our products and services.

    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales and product development, to drive product adoption and customer success.

  • Customer Retention and Expansion:

    • Develop and execute initiatives to drive customer retention, reduce churn, and increase customer lifetime value.

    • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts, working closely with the sales team to drive revenue growth.

  • Customer Success Metrics and Reporting:

    • Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of the client success team and overall customer success efforts.

The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Dexcom’s Government Affairs team is responsible for advancing legislative, regulatory, and reimbursement policies that support patient access, innovation, and business growth. Working closely with federal, state, and international government affairs professionals, as well as policy, market access, regulatory, and executive leadership teams, the Lead Senior Manager of Federal Government Affairs will help drive Dexcom’s federal advocacy strategy and strengthen the company’s presence in Washington, D.C.

  • Lead the development and execution of Dexcom’s federal government affairs strategy to support business objectives and expand patient access to CGM technology.

  • Support executive engagement with policymakers and government stakeholders, including preparation of meetings and advocacy events.
  • Mentor and provide leadership to members of the Government Affairs team while helping strengthen the department’s long-term capabilities.

  • Deep understanding of the federal legislative and regulatory process.
  • Proven ability to influence public policy outcomes through strategic engagement and coalition building.
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare policy, reimbursement, medical technology, and federal health agencies.
  • Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to navigate complex and rapidly evolving policy environments.
  • Strong strategic thinking, project management, and cross-functional leadership capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines.

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.

  • Established network of relationships within Congress, the Administration, trade associations, and healthcare stakeholder organizations.
  • Experience leading complex policy initiatives and advocacy campaigns.

  • Experience advocating on behalf of a medical device, biotechnology, digital health, or healthcare company.
  • Understanding of diabetes policy, chronic disease management, and emerging healthcare technologies.
  • Experience managing consultants, coalition partners, and external advocacy resources.

Job Title – Project Manager

Department: Technology & Engineering
Reports to: Director of Technology Implementation
Location: Remote (U.S.)
Employment Type: Full Time

Description

The Project Manager serves as the delivery lead for a portfolio of concurrent, client-facing technology projects across Acrisure Cyber Services' managed services, infrastructure, cybersecurity, business continuity, disaster recovery, and strategic implementation practices. This role is responsible for the successful execution of projects from intake through closeout, ensuring delivery within scope, budget, timeline, and quality expectations while providing an exceptional client experience.

Working closely with clients, Solutions Engineers, Deployment Engineers, Client Success teams, Procurement, and internal stakeholders, the Project Manager is accountable for project planning, communication, resource coordination, risk management, financial oversight, and change control throughout the project lifecycle. This individual serves as the primary point of accountability for project success while maintaining strong relationships with both clients and internal teams.

Project Manager Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of concurrent client-facing technology projects from initiation through completion.
  • Own project scope, schedule, budget, client communication, quality, risk management, and change control throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Ensure projects meet key performance objectives related to budget adherence, delivery timelines, and client satisfaction.
  • Review project documentation including Statements of Work, engineering scope, procurement requirements, and project readiness prior to project kickoff.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, resource assignments, and project documentation.
  • Facilitate internal project kickoffs, client kickoff meetings, recurring status meetings, and project closeout sessions.
  • Provide regular project status updates, meeting recaps, executive summaries, and timely communication to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Coordinate resources across engineering, professional services, procurement, and third-party vendors to ensure successful project execution.
  • Monitor project budgets, labor utilization, burn rates, milestone completion, and project financial performance.
  • Proactively identify project risks, issues, dependencies, and blockers while driving timely resolution and appropriate escalation.
  • Manage formal project change requests, scope modifications, and associated documentation to ensure alignment between project objectives and client expectations.
  • Coordinate project scheduling to maximize resource utilization while maintaining delivery commitments.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation within PSA and project management platforms.
  • Partner with Client Success, Technical Account Managers, and Service teams to ensure successful project transition into ongoing support.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of PMO standards, documentation, templates, processes, and project delivery methodologies.

Who You Are:

  • At least 3 years of experience managing client-facing technology projects within an MSP, IT consulting, or professional services environment.
  • Focus on customer service - We are passionate about going above and beyond to provide our customers with excellent service. We expect you to be of the same mindset.
  • Demonstrated history of job stability – We invest a lot in our employees. We are looking for candidates who want a career, not a short-term gig.
  • Accountability – You are reliable and take responsibility for the tasks assigned to you.
  • Calm under pressure with the ability to confidently manage competing priorities and challenging client situations.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail with excellent documentation and project planning skills.
  • On occasion, we do require work outside of our standard business hours to accommodate client needs.

Experience/Skills Required

  • 3+ years managing multiple concurrent client-facing technology projects.
  • Experience delivering projects within managed services, IT consulting, or professional services organizations.
  • Proven experience managing project scope, budgets, schedules, risks, and client communications.
  • Experience with fixed-fee, time and materials, and managed services implementation engagements.
  • Hands-on experience using PSA platforms such as ConnectWise Manage (preferred), HaloPSA, Autotask, or similar.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional technical resources including engineers, consultants, vendors, and third-party partners.
  • Strong understanding of project planning, resource management, budgeting, and project financial tracking.
  • Experience facilitating client meetings, executive status updates, and project governance.
  • Excellent written documentation skills including project plans, meeting summaries, status reports, and closeout documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making abilities.

Experience/Skills Preferred

  • PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2, CSM, or other project management certification.
  • Experience delivering managed services onboardings, infrastructure deployments, cybersecurity initiatives, business continuity, or disaster recovery projects.
  • Familiarity with ConnectWise Manage and related platforms including ConnectWise Automate, Control, Auvik, and Microsoft 365 administration.
  • Experience overseeing Microsoft 365, Azure, cloud migration, or hybrid infrastructure projects.
  • Experience working with clients in regulated industries including healthcare, financial services, legal, or manufacturing.
  • Experience developing or improving PMO processes, templates, project standards, or delivery methodologies.

About Acrisure Cyber Services:

Acrisure Cyber Services is a full-service technology partner that helps businesses attain greater success and profitability through the strategic alignment of business objectives and technology. Whether it be managed infrastructure and devices, helpdesk support, holistic best-in-class cybersecurity, strategic cyber executive services or digital transformation our flat-rate billing model provides the predictability businesses need to securely and effectively budget and scale for growth. Our value is not measured in how much time is spent implementing or supporting technology, but rather on how we’ve helped our clients leverage technology to achieve their business goals

  • You’ll work with extremely passionate, driven and experienced technical professionals. This means we recognize (and love) brilliance and hard work. We are totally focused on learning, growing, and mentoring so that everyone can prosper in their careers and add value to ACS, each other, and our clients.
  • Relationships are important to us. We provide the highest levels of customer service and strive to always exceed our clients’ expectations. You will too.
  • We love collaborating and working together as a team. You can expect company sponsored events at your location.
  • As we’re a small company that has worked hard to create processes and metrics to measure our success, you will be noticed. This means that when you’re doing well, will be noticed. It also means if you’re not working, we’re going to notice.

Benefits & Perks

We offer a comprehensive benefits program designed to support the wellbeing of our employees and their families, including:

  • Multiple medical plan options, including PPO and HSA-compatible plans
  • Dental and vision coverage
  • Employer-paid basic life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Flexible spending and health savings account options
  • Paid time off, holidays, and additional leave programs
  • Access to wellness resources, support programs, and employee discounts

$90,000—$105,000 USD

jobs.description:
The Atria Health Institute is a membership-based primary and specialty health care practice with a focus on prevention and longevity. We bring together a multidisciplinary team of renowned physicians to provide proactive, preventive, and precision-based care for Atria members and their families. All care, including primary care, advanced screening and diagnostics, urgent care, specialty care, 24/7 home visits, and imaging is included in members’ annual fee.

We have state-of-the-art facilities with imaging and diagnostics on-site in New York City, Palm Beach, and Los Angeles, with home services hubs in Miami, Greenwich/Westchester, and the Hamptons in summer. Additional locations are forthcoming in the Bay Area, Miami, and in downtown Manhattan. At each of our Institutes, we deliver personalized preventive medicine grounded in up-to-the-minute science — all in serene environments designed for trust and comfort.

About this role

The Security Operations Administrator is a founding member of our security team responsible for supporting the deployment, day-to-day administration, maintenance, monitoring, and operational effectiveness of Atria’s cybersecurity platforms. This role will help strengthen Atria’s cybersecurity maturity by ensuring core security tools are properly maintained, documented, tuned, and operationally aligned with IT, Engineering, and business needs.

This position will work closely with the IT Team, Engineering Team, vendors, and implementation partners to support Atria’s growing cybersecurity program. The role is intended for a hands-on security operations professional who can manage practical administrative tasks while having significant opportunity to mature our overall security program over time.

Reporting Structure

Reports to: VP of Information Technology

Works closely with: Software Foundations team (leadership, Platform and DevOps Team Leads), IT Help Desk, vendors, and implementation partners

Responsibilities

The Security Operations Administrator will be responsible for supporting the ongoing operation of Atria’s cybersecurity tools and related processes, including:

  • Administer and maintain assigned cybersecurity platforms, including, Zscaler, Armis,, SentinelOne and related systems.
  • Support daily security operations activities, including alert review and tuning, triage, escalation, and follow-up tracking.
  • Support our MSSP with alert configuration, runbooks, tuning.
  • Assist with the ongoing administration of identity, endpoint, asset management, privileged access, and email security controls.
  • Support asset discovery, inventory validation, asset tagging, ownership mapping, and reconciliation across multiple platforms.
  • Maintain accurate documentation for platform ownership, administrative access, configuration standards, operational procedures, and support workflows.
  • Coordinate with vendors and certified partners after implementation to ensure proper handoff, knowledge transfer, and operational readiness.
  • Assist with user-reported phishing workflows, email security investigations, and awareness-related follow-up.
  • Support privileged access management processes, access reviews, credential lifecycle tasks, and exception tracking.

  • Prepare recurring operational reports for IT leadership, and executive stakeholders.
  • Track remediation items, open issues, platform risks, and operational gaps through completion.
  • Collaborate with IT and Engineering on patching, configuration management, endpoint compliance, and device security workflows as needed.
  • Participate in security incidents, investigations, tabletop exercises, and maturity improvement initiatives as needed.

Key Platforms and Technology Areas

This role may support or coordinate across the following technology areas:

  • Email security
  • Asset discovery and inventory
  • Endpoint detection and response
  • Endpoint management
  • Mobile device management
  • Identity and access management
  • Privileged access management
  • Network security
  • Cloud security
  • Backup and recovery
  • Vulnerability and patch management
  • Security reporting and documentation

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in IT operations, security operations, systems administration, endpoint administration, or a related technical role.
  • Practical experience administering security or infrastructure platforms in a small to mid-sized environment.
  • Working knowledge of identity, endpoint, asset management, patching, and security operations concepts.
  • Experience with one or more of the following tools; Okta, Intune, Kandji, SentinelOne, NinjaOne, Fortinet, Armis, Abnormal Security, Zscaler, Rubrik, GCP, Cloudflare, or GitHub security tooling.
  • Ability to perform basic security alert review, troubleshooting, and escalation.
  • Strong documentation skills, including the ability to create runbooks, procedures, checklists, and operational tracking documents.
  • Ability to work across IT, DevOps, security, and vendor teams.
  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a small-team environment.
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, research, or other regulated environments.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA, privacy, data protection, or clinical operations.
  • Experience supporting cloud environments, especially Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with privileged access management or identity governance.
  • Experience with asset discovery, CMDB cleanup, device ownership mapping, or inventory normalization.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks such as CIS Controls or NIST CSF.
  • Familiarity with emerging artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities and their application across relevant cybersecurity domains including but not limited to; network security, Identity, endpoint management and data security.
  • Certifications such as Security+, CySA+, SSCP, Okta, Google Cloud, or other relevant vendor certifications.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Improved ownership and administration of cybersecurity platforms.

Role Scope

This is a hands-on operational role. The Security Operations Administrator is not expected to independently design Atria’s full cybersecurity strategy or own all security risk decisions. Instead, this role is responsible for helping ensure that Atria’s cybersecurity platforms are properly administered, monitored, documented, and used effectively.

jobs.description:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to our patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions. We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of healthcare. Clover's engineering team is empathetic, caring, and supportive.

We are looking for a Software Developer, Engineering Productivity with expertise in backend infrastructure, platform engineering, and SDLC observability to join our globally distributed engineering team. You won't just write code to spec — you'll understand the business problem, engage with stakeholders, and shape the solution. In this role, your customers are our own engineers: you will act as a high-leverage technical bridge between Quality and Eng Core, building the automated safety nets and engineering telemetry required to increase deployment velocity while driving code-related incidents to zero.

Our engineering team is spread across time zones, and this role works closely with colleagues in Hong Kong. In practice that means regular early-morning or evening calls — we keep the load shared fairly, but comfort with that rhythm matters for this role.

As a Software Developer, Engineering Productivity, you will:

  • Design and champion internal Quality Programms: Drive engineering-wide process changes and ensure pods adopt new reliability standards without friction. You will operate with a product-owner mindset to define and evangelize the internal reliability roadmap.
  • Build SDLC observability pipelines: Harness the APIs across our existing stack (GitHub, Linear, GCP, Sentry, Grafana, incident.io) to collect, aggregate, and visualize engineering and quality telemetry — delivering self-service dashboards that give Engineering Managers and pod leads clear visibility into delivery efficiency and SDLC bottlenecks.
  • Define and enforce hard metrics: Establish and automate reporting for the Key Quality Indicators that objectively describe deployment health — Change Failure Rate, Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Time to Restore, Regression Rate, Release Failure Rate, PR-failure rate, and code review depth — creating a quantifiable baseline for platform reliability.
  • Architect Shift-Left Pipeline Gates: Weave automated Performance, Security, and Accessibility checks directly into the CI/CD pipeline at the PR level in tight partnership with Eng Core.
  • Build Real-World Load Testing: Shift load and performance testing left for every customer onboarding, validating real-world assumptions using tools such as k6, Locust, Gatling, or JMeter.
  • Engineer Synthetic Data & Production Canaries: Build the architecture for safe synthetic data injection to unblock heavy load-testing and live-production canaries, strictly isolating test data from authentic user telemetry.
  • Leverage Generative AI Tooling: Actively utilize AI assistants (e.g., Gemini, Claude, Cursor, Codex) to accelerate the development of testing frameworks, automate infrastructure code, and design advanced testing architectures.
  • Drive Tooling Consolidation: Lead the technical migration away from expensive, legacy testing infrastructure to a unified, AI-supported automation stack — maximizing the value of the platforms we already have rather than introducing unnecessary vendor complexity.
  • Help define and maintain development practices: Enable fast iteration while ensuring quality, including writing tests and documenting key implementations.

Success in this role looks like:

  • You operate as a high-leverage Individual Contributor (IC) and reliability champion, effectively negotiating with engineering pods and leadership to roll out and adopt critical quality processes across the entire SDLC.
  • You operate with a strong bias for action—designing automated systems that actively enforce our reliability thresholds and comfortably holding the line on quality standards when deployments are at risk.
  • You have made engineering health measurable. Delivery efficiency and software quality are no longer subjective conversations — they are numbers on a dashboard that leadership and pod leads both trust and act on.
  • You have delivered impactful projects that advance our engineering roadmap, reducing toil or streamlining operations.
  • You have built trusted partnerships across engineering teams and contribute to the success of their projects where needed.
  • You proactively identify opportunities to improve how we build, deploy, and scale – bringing a thoughtful, systems-oriented lens to everything from infrastructure to process.

You should get in touch if:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software with proficiency in one or more common languages (e.g., Python, Go), and are comfortable working across different technical systems and concerns.
  • You have worked at a systems level with modern developer infrastructure and production telemetry, and can query, combine, and process data from tool APIs — ours are GitHub, Linear, GCP, Sentry, Grafana and incident.io, but equivalents like GitLab, Jira or Datadog count just as much. You have built the mechanisms that make engineering health visible, not just consumed someone else's dashboard.
  • You have personally instrumented hard quality metrics — several of Change Failure Rate, Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Time to Restore, Regression Rate, Release Failure Rate, PR-failure rate, code review depth, or SLIs/SLOs and error budgets — rather than just referenced them.
  • You have a strong product-oriented mindset, care about outcomes over output, and want to understand the "why" behind what you build to connect your work to business impact.
  • You have experience building and refactoring complex (often distributed) systems and possess experience with declarative infrastructure as code (IaC) deployment patterns.
  • You have experience with public cloud platforms such as GCP and/or AWS.
  • You have — or are keen to build — hands-on experience with load and performance testing (k6, Locust, Gatling, JMeter all welcome), including handling synthetic data safely so test traffic never contaminates real user telemetry.
  • You have AI experience in terms of testing tools and architecture. You know how to build systems with AI agents as your partners, and you possess clear strategies for strictly verifying and validating AI-generated code and infrastructure outputs before they merge.
  • You have excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and are able to adapt quickly to new challenges and technologies.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive group medical coverage that include coverage for hospitalization, outpatient care, optical services, and dental benefits.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous annual leave policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: We are committed to developing our talent professionally. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Flexibility to work from home, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.

Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.

With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.

  • Security-as-a-Service Approach: Designing and operating security services as a scalable platform. Building "self-service" security primitives (e.g., Identity-as-a-Service, automated secrets management, and real-time scanning APIs) that allow developer teams to move fast.

  • Security Tooling & Lifecycle: Develop internal security frameworks and automated response systems. Responsible for the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) of the security tools, including testing, deployment, and maintenance.

  • Threat Modeling & System Design: Conduct deep-dive threat models on complex distributed systems and the DGX Cloud stack, identifying architectural gaps in security and engineering the solutions to close them.

  • Multi-Functional Collaboration: Partner with DGX Cloud platform teams, broader NVIDIA security teams, and product engineering to understand their needs and build paved paths that seamlessly embed security into the CI/CD pipeline and the hardware lifecycle.

What We Need to See:

We are looking for high-caliber engineers with deep spikes of expertise in a few of these areas and the intellectual curiosity to dive into the rest. If your experience aligns with the core of this role—building resilient security systems—and you can show us how, we want to hear from you!

  • Production-Grade Coding: A strong software engineering background with the ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. You should be comfortable building and maintaining production service at scale.

  • Distributed Systems Expertise: Understanding of cloud-native architecture, container orchestration (Kubernetes), and the security challenges inherent in high-throughput, low-latency environments.

  • Platformizing Security: Transform complex security requirements into consumable internal services. You will focus on the "Developer Experience" of security, ensuring that our infrastructure security controls are delivered as robust, API-first platforms that integrate seamlessly with NVIDIA’s internal engineering workflows.

  • Security Product Integration: Proven track record of taking complex security products (AuthN/AuthZ, Vaulting, Scanning, IDS) and integrating them into an automated infrastructure via APIs and custom glue-code.

  • Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).

Ways To Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • HPC/AI Security: Experience securing high-performance computing environments, RDMA-based networks, or GPU-specific security challenges.

  • Cloud-Native Identity: Expertise in workload identity frameworks (e.g., SPIFFE/SPIRE) and hardware-root-of-trust (TPM/HSM) integration.

  • Open Source Impact: Notable contributions to security-focused open-source projects or a track record of engineering-focused security research. How have you represented and helped advance the industry?

jobs.description:
About Customs Support Group

Customs Support Group (CSG) is Europe’s leading independent customs services provider. Founded in 1964, we operate in 14 European countries with 100+ offices and a team of 1,700+ customs professionals.

We help companies move goods across borders smoothly and compliantly, taking the pressure out of customs.

What we do: We support more than 60,000 clients and process over 20 million declaration lines each year.
From day‑to‑day customs declarations to compliance, duty optimization and trade advice, we make cross‑border trade easier and more predictable.

How we work: We combine local customs expertise with modern digital tools to handle large volumes accurately and at speed.
Our technology helps teams work smarter, reduces manual effort, and improves turnaround times. In markets like the UK, this already led to clear productivity gains.

Why it matter: Customs rules are becoming more complex and mistakes are costly. Delays, compliance risks and unclear regulations can slow businesses down.
CSG helps clients stay compliant, reduce risk and keep their supply chains moving.

Why Join Us

At CSG, you will be part of a growing international organization that is improving how customs work gets done.

You will:

  • Work with experienced customs professionals and technology teams

  • Gain exposure to international trade and complex supply chains

  • Contribute to services that have a real impact on global commerce

This is a chance to build a career in a stable but evolving industry, where expertise and good judgement still matter.

Purpose of the Position

Customs Support Group is expanding its presence in Spain, and this role exists to make that happen properly. As a PE-backed business that has completed over 20 acquisitions across Europe, we know that the quality of integration work in the first 12 months determines whether an acquisition delivers its value or creates years of operational drag.

This is a 1-year fixed-term contract, remote-based in Spain, with periodic travel to acquired sites across the country. You will own integration delivery for the Spanish market, working closely with local leadership, functional teams, and the Group Strategy and Integration Office to ensure newly acquired entities are brought into the CSG operating model effectively and on time.

It is a defined scope with a clear mandate. If you are someone who gets things done, works well without hand-holding, and knows how to navigate the complexity of post-acquisition environments, this role will suit you.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of post-merger integration projects for CSG's Spanish acquisitions, managing scope, planning, milestones, risks, and stakeholder reporting.

  • Identify and manage interdependencies between workstreams (HR, IT, Operations, Finance, Commercial) and escalate blockers before they become issues.

  • Act as the primary integration contact for Spain, reporting regularly to the Head of Strategy and Integration Office and relevant C-level stakeholders.

  • Drive alignment between acquired Spanish entities and CSG Group standards, processes, and systems -- balancing speed of integration with operational continuity.

  • Facilitate structured integration workshops, decision checkpoints, and lessons-learned reviews on-site and remotely.

  • Contribute to the development of integration methodology and playbooks that can be applied to future acquisitions within Spain and across the Group.

  • Support any M&A due diligence activities where on-the-ground Spanish market knowledge adds value.

What We Are Looking For

  • 3+ years of project management experience,

  • Experience with post-merger integration, business transformation, or management consulting is highy desirable

  • Hands-on experience with integration methodology, IMO setup, Day 1 readiness, workstream management, synergy tracking. You have done this, not just studied it.

  • Comfortable working independently in a remote setup while staying closely connected to a distributed team across Europe.

  • Confident communicator at all levels, from site managers to executive sponsors. You can hold a room, give honest status updates, and push back when needed.

  • Based in Spain with the flexibility to travel to acquired locations across the country as integration activities require.

  • Spanish and English fluency -- both are essential for this role. You will be working with local teams in Spanish and reporting to Group leadership in English.

  • Proficiency with standard PM tools (MS Project, Jira, or equivalent) and MS Office.

  • PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification is a plus, not a requirement.

Waters Advanced Diagnostics is seeking a Director, Medical Affairs, to provide strategic and scientific leadership across the Medical Affairs function. This role will help shape how clinical, scientific, and market insights inform product strategy across microbiology, molecular, point-of-care, and other high-value diagnostic workflows in regulated clinical settings.

The Director serves as a senior Medical Affairs representative, partnering closely with Research and Development, Clinical Affairs, Regulatory, Quality, Commercial, and other cross-functional leaders. This individual translates unmet customer and patient needs, evolving clinical practice, and real-world evidence into actionable medical strategies that strengthen product differentiation, support lifecycle decisions, and enable successful development and adoption of innovative diagnostic solutions.

This role leads new product development and product lifecycle management, while guiding scalable, data-driven, and AI-enabled approaches to planning, execution, and performance management. The Director is expected to bring deep diagnostic and laboratory expertise, strong business acumen, and a collaborative leadership style to advance medical credibility, innovation, and patient impact across Waters Advanced Diagnostics.

Responsibilities

  • Lead Medical Affairs strategy and execution for the Advanced Diagnostics Division
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including R&D, marketing, sales, and regulatory, to ensure a cohesive and integrated approach to medical affairs.
  • Identify evidence gaps and contribute to real‑world evidence, clinical research, and publication strategies in partnership with marketing and R&D teams.
  • Serve as a scientific advisor for internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Stay up to date on industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activities to inform the development of innovative strategies and initiatives.
  • Partner with laboratory medicine organizations and serve as a thought leader, representing the company at conferences, events, and with key opinion leaders.
  • Provide strategic input and guidance to product development teams to ensure the company's portfolio meets the needs of healthcare professionals and patients.
  • Lead the adoption of AI-enabled tools to improve operational efficiency, reporting, and workflow management
  • Guide teams in effectively leveraging AI tools, acting as a resource for adoption and best practices
  • Establish and evolve key metrics to measure Medical Affairs performance and impactTranslate complex medical/scientific data into actionable business insights.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning within the medical affairs team and across the organization.
  • Act as a mentor and coach to team members, providing guidance and support in their professional development and growth.

Qualifications

  • Advanced medical or scientific degree in the life sciences or related field
  • 10+ years of experience as Director of a Clinical Microbiology Laboratory or equivalent leadership roles in laboratory medicine, infectious disease diagnostics, or precision medicine environments preferred.
  • Demonstrated leadership and team management experience
  • In-depth knowledge of newly developing technology in the field of infectious diseases diagnostics, scientific study design and implementation, as well as data analysis of study findings.

We collaborate with customers around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, ensure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combating antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, our passionate team of ~16,000 colleagues turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide.

This role owns onboarding, continuous development, and coaching for global Sales and Sales Engineering teams, Customer Success, and for our channel partners, working closely with stakeholders across the organization. The emphasis is on coaching and field development. It also builds our AI-assisted enablement function, spanning conversation intelligence, practice and simulation, and content operations. This role reports to the VP, Revenue Operations, and sits inside the revenue engine alongside pipeline, forecast, and productivity data.

Anomali is growing. We are known for a fast-paced and dynamic environment with a culture focused on career growth, success, and winning!

Key Responsibilities:

Coaching and Field Development

  • Run the coaching system end to end: call coaching, deal coaching, and opportunity inspection alongside sales leadership. You are in live deals every week, not adjacent to them.
  • Coach the coaches. Build and certify frontline sales managers on a consistent coaching cadence, language, and quality bar so capability scales past any one person.
  • Own a seller competency model with observable behaviors by stage and by persona. Assess against it, not just train against it.
  • Diagnose precisely. Tell the difference between a skill gap, a knowledge gap, a message gap, and a management gap, then route each to the right fix instead of defaulting to more training.
  • Sit in forecast and pipeline reviews as a contributor: identify the recurring seller behaviors behind slipped and lost deals, and close them.

Platform-Selling

  • Evolve the sales narrative and discovery motion for platform selling: multi-product and multi-stakeholder.

Category position is the work; the narrative cascade is only the output.

AbriCare was founded with the mission to put caregivers first. The best care for clients starts with supporting the people who deliver it. The Vice President, Growth is a strategic and execution-oriented sales leader responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive growth strategy that drives census growth, referral volume, and market expansion across AbriCare's Personal Care Services platform. The role ensures high performance, strategic alignment, and drives market expansion. This leader will build referral pipelines, develop market-level growth strategies, and help stand up the commercial infrastructure required to scale a multi-region platform.   • Experience in Missouri and/or Ohio, with demonstrated understanding of state specific Medicaid waiver programs and AAA referral processes
  • Track record of driving organic growth (not solely acquisition-driven growth) in multi-site environments

You will possess extensive expertise in working with diverse data storage technologies, including databases, data lakes, and data warehouses, as well as streaming architectures and service layer technologies. You are proficient in programming languages such as Python, Scala, Java, and SQL. Your skillset extends to encompass data integration, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, ELT (Extract, Load, Transform), Restful/GRPC services, Streaming, and the construction and abstraction of robust data pipelines. The overarching objective as a Data Platform Engineer is to enable enterprise product teams to deliver quality data products that drive business insight and value to our customers. This includes building tooling and services that connects data sources to data consumers and ensures the accessibility, structural integrity, and reliability of data to fulfill analytical and business imperatives.

  • Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to MVP optimal solutions
  • Collaborate with data governance teams and data platform architects to build governance into technical solutions
  • Maintain systems and services that provide transparency and observability into our critical systems
  • Implement and promote engineering and architectural patterns, perform code reviews, and collaborate in architectural reviews
  • Collaborate with product team data engineers and architects to MVP data products, maintain data models, and promote data modeling best practice
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to product and data engineers, guiding their growth and professional development and enabling their ability to use platform tooling and services
  • Lead by example through hands-on contributions to designing, coding, and troubleshooting complex data systems
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks and optimization opportunities within data pipelines, databases, and processing frameworks
  • Optimize data processing workflows to improve efficiency and reduce latency
  • Lead efforts to diagnose and resolve data-related incidents in a timely manner
  • Will participate in the grooming of stories
  • Will be responsible for their own tasking towards the completion of stories
  • Will mentor junior members of the team and guide junior members on best practice
  • Will participate in design
  • Will be responsible for the quality of their own code and will participate in code review of others product
  • Will be responsible for integrating their own code with the team's DevOps plan and implementation

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

Minimum Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years relevant experience
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Information Technology or a related computer degree or equivalent experience. Master’s degree is a plus
  • Must know and have proficiency in one object or object/functional programing language. Preferably Python
  • Must know common object and object/functional design patterns. Builder, factory, façade, context, etc.

  • Must know data lake and lake house design principles, OLTP (Online Transaction Processing) design principles, document data stores, and graph

You won't be inheriting an enablement machine.

You'll build it.
