jobs.title: Senior Accounts Payable Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Hello.  We’re Teya. Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.
jobs.description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

Your Mission

As a Senior Accounts Payable Analyst, your mission is to ensure the integrity, efficiency and continuous improvement of Teya's Accounts Payable function.

You will act as a subject-matter expert across the end-to-end Purchase-to-Pay process, taking ownership of complex AP matters, supplier accounts, payment runs, month-end deliverables and AP controls.

You will work closely with Finance, Procurement, suppliers and wider business teams to resolve issues, improve P2P compliance and strengthen our processes. You will also play a key role in Finance projects, automation initiatives and the continued development of Teya's Finance Shared Services function.

This is a hands-on senior role with significant ownership and influence, where you will be expected to identify problems, challenge existing processes and drive improvements through to implementation.

Your Role & Responsibilities

Accounts Payable Operations

  • Act as a subject-matter expert for the end-to-end Purchase-to-Pay cycle, handling the most complex, high-value and non-standard invoices, tax treatments and entity-specific cases.

  • Own the integrity of the AP ledger, including supplier reconciliations, aged balances, duplicate invoices, blocked items and unmatched transactions.

  • Investigate discrepancies and drive issues through to resolution, ensuring accurate and timely maintenance of supplier accounts.

  • Own the payment run process, ensuring completeness, accuracy, appropriate authorisation, fraud controls and execution within agreed timelines.

  • Contribute to prioritisation of the AP queue and workload, ensuring urgent, overdue and high-risk items are addressed within agreed service levels.

  • Act as a senior point of contact for suppliers and internal stakeholders, handling escalations independently and applying sound commercial judgement.

  • Partner with Procurement and business owners to improve P2P compliance, reduce invoice exceptions and strengthen upstream discipline.

Month-End & Reporting

  • Own AP deliverables for month-end close, including AP cut-off, accruals, GRNI and open-item reviews, reconciliations and reporting.

  • Prepare and maintain AP reports, dashboards and reconciliations, highlighting risks, overdue items, process gaps and recommended actions.

  • Present findings, risks and recommendations clearly to Finance management and non-Finance stakeholders.

  • Support wider Finance Operations activities where required, including intercompany transactions, employee and corporate card reconciliations and expense processes.

Controls, Compliance & Audit

  • Maintain clear and complete AP processes, controls and procedures in line with audit, governance and internal control standards.

  • Support the design and testing of AP controls, ensuring appropriate approvals, segregation of duties and fraud prevention measures are maintained.

  • Act as a key contact for internal and external audit on AP matters, providing supporting documentation, explanations and follow-up actions.

  • Identify control weaknesses and recurring issues, recommend practical solutions and ensure improvements are effectively embedded.

Process Improvement & Projects

  • Identify root causes of recurring AP exceptions and lead improvement initiatives end to end, from proposal through to implementation and embedded change.

  • Represent AP in Finance projects, including system implementations, process migrations, entity integrations and automation initiatives.

  • Contribute to requirements gathering, process design, testing, cutover and post-go-live stabilisation.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate AP processes while maintaining appropriate controls and service quality.

  • Support the continued development of scalable, efficient and controlled Finance Shared Services processes.

Team Support & Development

  • Provide guidance, coaching and technical support to junior team members, helping raise consistency and quality across the team.

  • Review work and provide constructive feedback, ensuring processes and controls are consistently followed.

  • Act as a technical point of reference for complex AP queries and transactions.

  • Share knowledge, best practices and process updates across the team.

  • Support workload prioritisation and service delivery without formal line-management responsibility.


What We're Looking For

  • Solid experience in Accounts Payable or a broader Finance Operations environment, ideally within a complex, multi-entity or shared services organisation.

  • Strong understanding of the end-to-end Purchase-to-Pay process, including invoice processing, supplier reconciliations, payments and AP controls.

  • Proven experience handling complex, high-value or non-standard invoices and resolving challenging supplier account issues.

  • Strong experience with month-end close activities, including AP cut-off, accruals, GRNI, reconciliations and open-item reviews.

  • Experience owning or supporting payment runs, including approval processes, controls and fraud prevention.

  • Experience contributing to Finance projects such as system implementations, process migrations, entity integrations or automation initiatives.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate root causes and drive issues through to resolution.

  • Strong attention to detail and a controls-focused approach.

  • Experience supporting audits and maintaining process and control documentation.

  • Comfortable acting as a senior point of contact for suppliers, Finance, Procurement and wider business stakeholders.

  • Experience coaching or supporting junior team members and acting as a technical point of reference.

  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise competing demands and manage time-sensitive and high-risk activities.

  • A continuous improvement mindset, with an interest in process automation, systems and operational efficiency.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to present findings and recommendations to Finance management and non-Finance stakeholders.

  • Fluent English; Portuguese is an advantage.


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary.

  • Flexible hybrid working.

  • Health Insurance.

  • Life Insurance.

  • Meal Allowance.

  • Wellhub membership, providing access to gyms, fitness, therapy, wellbeing and nutrition services.

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave.

  • 25 days annual leave.

  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.

  • Collaborative, informal and high-performing working environment.

  • Regular company and team events.

  • The opportunity to play a critical role in building a scalable, best-in-class Finance Shared Services function supporting Teya's continued growth across Europe.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
jobs.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Technical Product Lead, AI Email App, you work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and engineering constraints. You will work directly with ML and engineering teams to define how the system should behave, how we measure it, and how we continuously improve it.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You are expected to understand the system and challenge technical decisions.

What You'll Own

  • Define end-to-end requirements for AI capabilities, from model behavior to system behavior to user experience.

  • Translate model capabilities, evaluation results, and technical constraints into clear product and system decisions.

  • Make trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and UX.

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and client engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration.

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback.

  • Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences.

  • Drive execution through clear specifications, prioritization, and strong technical judgment.

  • Identify failure modes and ensure AI systems behave predictably and recover gracefully.

  • Own product quality end-to-end, correctness, reliability, usefulness, and user trust.

What We're Looking For

Technical

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills.

  • Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production.

  • Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers.

  • Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, and failure modes.

Product & AI

  • Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered products, particularly LLM-based systems.

  • Experience with model evaluation, experimentation, prompting, or AI system iteration.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable plans.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions when the right answer is not obvious.

Mindset

  • Highly technical, curious, and comfortable going deep.

  • Strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and learning from real-world usage.

  • Able to challenge engineers and researchers constructively while maintaining strong collaboration.

  • Comfortable operating with significant ownership in a fast-moving, zero-to-one environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.

  • Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.

  • Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling.

  • Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

An engineering background is a strong plus, but what matters most is the ability to reason deeply about both AI systems and product outcomes.

Outcomes

  • Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities.

  • AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.

  • Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty.

  • Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback.

  • Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers and product leaders have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

jobs.excerpt: Wir bei SoSafe haben das Ziel, der führende Anbieter für Human Risk Management Lösungen in Europa zu werden.
jobs.description:
Wir bei SoSafe haben das Ziel, der führende Anbieter für Human Risk Management Lösungen in Europa zu werden. Unsere preisgekrönte Awareness-Plattform unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, nachhaltige Verhaltensänderungen durch effektive, interaktive Trainings rund um Cyber-Sicherheit und Datenschutz zu erzielen. Prognosen zufolge wird Cyberkriminalität die Welt bis 2025 jährlich 10,5 Billionen Dollar kosten – werde Teil der Lösung und gestalte die Zukunft der Cybersicherheit aktiv mit!

Als Account Executive im Public Sector (m/w/d) wirst du Teil eines dynamischen, ambitionierten und internationalen Vertriebsteams, das auf Zusammenarbeit, Wissensaustausch und die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Vertriebsprozessen setzt. Erfolg treibt uns an – und in unserer offenen, motivierenden Teamkultur macht das Erreichen von Zielen gleich doppelt so viel Freude.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Sales Development Representative (SDR) Team zusammen, baust dein Netzwerk kontinuierlich aus und übertriffst deine Vertriebsziele. Du verstehst die speziellen Herausforderungen und Bedürfnisse öffentlicher Institutionen und weißt, wie du unsere Cybersecurity-Lösungen überzeugend positionierst.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Eigenverantwortliche Akquise neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im Public Sector in der DACH-Region

  • Management des gesamten Sales-Zyklus – von der ersten Ansprache über Angebote bis zum Vertragsabschluss

  • Zusammenarbeit mit SDRs zur Identifikation und Qualifizierung von Leads, um eine stabile Sales-Pipeline sicherzustellen

  • Steuerung, Verhandlung und Abschluss von Cross- und Upselling-Möglichkeiten in Zusammenarbeit mit Customer Success Managern

  • Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Beziehungen zu Entscheidungsträgern im öffentlichen Sektor

  • Durchführung von Online-Demos, Vor-Ort-Terminen und Events, um unsere Cybersecurity-Lösungen zu präsentieren

Das bringst du mit:

  • 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Closing-Rolle im SaaS-Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Fokus im öffentlichen Sektor oder starkem Interesse an Public Sector Sales in DACH

  • Verantwortung, Initiative und Ownership – du bringst Deals mit Disziplin und Konsequenz zum Abschluss

  • Teamfähigkeit und Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit cross-funktionalen Teams

  • Proaktive, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und Anpassungsfähigkeit in einem dynamischen Umfeld

  • Erfahrung mit CRM-Tools (z. B. Salesforce, HubSpot), Prospecting-Software und LinkedIn Sales Navigator

  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

  • Standort: Köln / deutschlandweit (Remote) - bei uns arbeitest du hauptsächlich remote und kommst für regelmäßige Teamtage nach Köln (z. B. monatlich).

Was wir bieten*:

  • Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 33 Tage Urlaub und zusätzliche finanzielle Unterstützung während der Elternzeit

  • Well-being und finanzielle Unterstützung: Zugang zur Open-Up App, Mitarbeiterrabatte, sowie Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits mit Urban Sports Club

  • Verbindung & Gemeinschaft: Virtuelle Events, gemeinsame Teamaktivitäten und Möglichkeiten für lokale Treffen

  • Und vieles mehr: Technische Ausstattung, Empfehlungsprämien, ein individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget, hundefreundliches Büro

*Die oben genannten Vergünstigungen gelten für Vollzeitmitarbeiter und können je nach Standort leicht variieren. Dies ist nur eine Auswahl – mehr erfahren Sie im Verlauf des Bewerbungsprozesses.

Über uns

Wir bei SoSafe haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, die digitale Welt sicherer zu gestalten, indem wir den menschlichen Faktor in der Cybersicherheit in den Mittelpunkt stellen.
Als eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Security-Awareness-Scale-ups weltweit nutzen wir verhaltenswissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse und datengesteuertes Lernen, um Menschen effektiv gegen Cyber-Bedrohungen zu stärken. Unser Human Risk Management-Ansatz unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, ihre Mitarbeiter*innen zum wirkungsvollsten Schutzschild gegen Sicherheitsrisiken zu entwickeln.

Mit der Unterstützung führender VCs wie Highland Europe und Global Founders Capital expandieren wir weltweit in rasantem Tempo. Wir suchen Teamplayer, die sinnvolle Veränderungen im Bereich Cybersicherheit vorantreiben, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen wollen.

Wenn du in einem lebendigen, zielorientierten Umfeld aufblühst, das Innovation, Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit großschreibt – dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

jobs.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Lead Software Engineer, AI Email Apps, you own the engineering layer that turns AI capability into a reliable product. You will shape the architecture across backend services, APIs, and client applications, while leading a small team of senior engineers.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You stay close to the code, make critical architectural decisions, and ensure the system remains fast, reliable, and coherent as it scales.

What You'll Own

  • Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop.

  • Design reliable systems for AI-powered workflows, including state, orchestration, tool use, retries, fallbacks, and failure handling.

  • Build the APIs and abstractions that connect AI systems to real-world product experiences.

  • Lead a small, senior engineering team and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship.

  • Make high-impact trade-offs across latency, reliability, cost, security, and user experience.

  • Establish strong production foundations: observability, monitoring, testing, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences.

  • Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.

  • Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.

  • Experience building AI-powered products or systems that integrate with modern ML/LLM capabilities.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable working across backend and client platforms, with deep expertise in at least one.

  • A strong bias toward ownership, shipping, and learning from real-world usage.

  • High standards for code quality, reliability, and engineering fundamentals.

Outcomes

  • Production systems are observable, monitored, and stable under real-world load.

  • Decisions consistently balance speed, cost, reliability, and user experience.

  • Features across backend, mobile, and desktop work smoothly and reliably.

  • Latency and reliability improve measurably over time.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Finance.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Philippines. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Philippines.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Technical Lead
jobs.excerpt: The RoleBJAK builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia.
jobs.description:
The Role

BJAK builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Technical Lead owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

  • Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Technical Lead, AI Email App
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
jobs.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Technical Lead, AI Email App, you own the engineering layer that turns AI capability into a reliable product. You will shape the architecture across backend services, APIs, and client applications, while leading a small team of senior engineers.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You stay close to the code, make critical architectural decisions, and ensure the system remains fast, reliable, and coherent as it scales.

What You'll Own

  • Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop.

  • Design reliable systems for AI-powered workflows, including state, orchestration, tool use, retries, fallbacks, and failure handling.

  • Build the APIs and abstractions that connect AI systems to real-world product experiences.

  • Lead a small, senior engineering team and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship.

  • Make high-impact trade-offs across latency, reliability, cost, security, and user experience.

  • Establish strong production foundations: observability, monitoring, testing, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences.

  • Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.

  • Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.

  • Experience building AI-powered products or systems that integrate with modern ML/LLM capabilities.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable working across backend and client platforms, with deep expertise in at least one.

  • A strong bias toward ownership, shipping, and learning from real-world usage.

  • High standards for code quality, reliability, and engineering fundamentals.

Outcomes

  • Production systems are observable, monitored, and stable under real-world load.

  • Decisions consistently balance speed, cost, reliability, and user experience.

  • Features across backend, mobile, and desktop work smoothly and reliably.

  • Latency and reliability improve measurably over time.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

jobs.title: Head of Service [Member Services & Operations]
jobs.excerpt: Money stress is the biggest productivity killer in the workplace - My Money Matters exists to change that.
jobs.description:
Money stress is the biggest productivity killer in the workplace - My Money Matters exists to change that. We're building an app that improves employees' finances automatically every pay day - giving them financial tools that directly improve their financial health with less effort.

Every pay day is an opportunity to build better money habits. We make it easy. Employees can accelerate retirement savings with tax-efficient pension top-ups, build a safety net effortlessly with auto savings, or access their already-earned salary ahead of pay day for emergencies.

For employers, fewer employees with money worries means more focus on work. We're trusted by major organisations including the NHS, and we're growing fast.

The role

Great service is how we earn trust and keep it. We’re looking for a Head of Service to lead our teams that make sure every employer and employee have great experience with My Money Matters, whether that is an employer with a query about their payroll files, or a member with questions about their account.

You’ll take ownership of our Operations and Member Services teams, supporting 470 employers and over half a million employees. You’ll manage the Operations Manager and Member Services Manager, and you’ll be focused on building a lean, automation-first, well-run function that scales as we grow.

This is a hands-on role for someone who instinctually understands process detail, loves automating and who has a real passion for great customer service.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and own the Operations and Member Services functions end-to-end, setting the strategy, standards and KPIs that defined a great employer and member experience.

  • Manage and develop the Operations and Member Services Managers, building a high performance, lean function, that scales efficiently as we grow.

  • Design and continuously improve our operational processes, controls and workflows, identifying opportunities to automate manual or repetitive tasks.

  • Set, track, and report on service levels, quality and efficiency metrics, driving continuous improvement across both teams.

  • Partner closely with our Head of Customer Success to ensure an aligned experience for all employers, from onboarding through to ongoing account management.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to feed operational insights into the roadmap and identify and flag risks early.

  • Act as the escalation point for complex employer or member cases or complaints.

  • Own workforce planning and resourcing for Operations and Member Services.

  • Build and own relationships within our operating environment e.g. pension providers, pension funds etc

On a typical day you might:

  • Review service level dashboards, looking to identify and remedy bottlenecks.

  • Review member complaints or contract drive trends, reviewing our processes to identify opportunities or solutions to reduce call volumes or frictions.

  • Work with Product and Engineering on discussing self-serve features that would reduce inbound contact volumes.

  • Coach and develop the Operations and Member Services Managers.

What we're looking for

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you:

  • Proven experience leading operations and customer service functions.

  • Experience managing managers and building and developing high-performance teams.

  • A strong process mindset, you enjoy mapping, designing, improving and building operational workflows.

  • Ability to utilise low code automation tools such as Zapier, power automate, n8n, make, alongside LLMs such as Claude

  • Confident and comfortable with data, using data to inform decision making and prioritisation.

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust and credibility quickly with employers and members.

  • Strong commercial awareness, with an understanding of how operational excellence links to retention, growth, and organisational revenues.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a B2B2C, employee benefits or financial wellbeing

  • Familiarly with pensions or wider financial service operations

Our Recruitment Process

Stage 1 | People & Culture Call – A conversation about your experience, motivations and what you’re looking for in your next role.

Stage 2 | Practical Exercise – A 45-minute live exercise. A briefing pack and relevant context will be provided in advance so you have time to review and prepare.

Stage 3 | Hiring Manager Interview – A 1-hour competency-based interview covering your Member Services and Operations experience, commercial thinking and approach to customer engagement.

Stage 4 | Meet the CEO – A final-stage conversation with our CEO.

Benefits

🇬🇧 Remote working within the UK
Work remotely from anywhere in the UK, giving you flexibility to work where you perform at your best.

🖥️ Home office budget
Receive a £200 annual budget to help you set up and improve your home working space.

🌴 Annual leave
25 days’ annual leave, increasing with tenure, plus the option to purchase up to 5 additional days each year.

🎂 Birthday off
Take your birthday off, because everyone deserves time to celebrate properly.

🤝 Collaborative team bonus
For non-commission roles, you’ll be part of our collaborative team bonus scheme, recognising shared success across the business.

💰 Pension scheme

Access to our pension scheme.

✨ Perkbox salary sacrifice schemes
Access salary sacrifice schemes through Perkbox, including car leasing, gym memberships and tech purchases.

🩺 Medical cashback scheme

Helping with everyday healthcare costs.

👶 Enhanced parental leave

Support during important life moments.

🎉 Team connection
Regular opportunities to connect as a team, including our annual Summer Conference.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
jobs.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Product Owner, AI Email App, you work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and engineering constraints. You will work directly with ML and engineering teams to define how the system should behave, how we measure it, and how we continuously improve it.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You are expected to understand the system and challenge technical decisions.

What You'll Own

  • Define end-to-end requirements for AI capabilities, from model behavior to system behavior to user experience.

  • Translate model capabilities, evaluation results, and technical constraints into clear product and system decisions.

  • Make trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and UX.

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and client engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration.

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback.

  • Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences.

  • Drive execution through clear specifications, prioritization, and strong technical judgment.

  • Identify failure modes and ensure AI systems behave predictably and recover gracefully.

  • Own product quality end-to-end, correctness, reliability, usefulness, and user trust.

What We're Looking For

Technical

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills.

  • Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production.

  • Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers.

  • Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, and failure modes.

Product & AI

  • Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered products, particularly LLM-based systems.

  • Experience with model evaluation, experimentation, prompting, or AI system iteration.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable plans.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions when the right answer is not obvious.

Mindset

  • Highly technical, curious, and comfortable going deep.

  • Strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and learning from real-world usage.

  • Able to challenge engineers and researchers constructively while maintaining strong collaboration.

  • Comfortable operating with significant ownership in a fast-moving, zero-to-one environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.

  • Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.

  • Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling.

  • Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

An engineering background is a strong plus, but what matters most is the ability to reason deeply about both AI systems and product outcomes.

Outcomes

  • Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities.

  • AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.

  • Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty.

  • Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback.

  • Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers and product leaders have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead, AI Email App
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
jobs.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Technical Product Lead, AI Email App, you work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and engineering constraints. You will work directly with ML and engineering teams to define how the system should behave, how we measure it, and how we continuously improve it.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You are expected to understand the system and challenge technical decisions.

What You'll Own

  • Define end-to-end requirements for AI capabilities, from model behavior to system behavior to user experience.

  • Translate model capabilities, evaluation results, and technical constraints into clear product and system decisions.

  • Make trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and UX.

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and client engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration.

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback.

  • Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences.

  • Drive execution through clear specifications, prioritization, and strong technical judgment.

  • Identify failure modes and ensure AI systems behave predictably and recover gracefully.

  • Own product quality end-to-end, correctness, reliability, usefulness, and user trust.

What We're Looking For

Technical

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills.

  • Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production.

  • Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers.

  • Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, and failure modes.

Product & AI

  • Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered products, particularly LLM-based systems.

  • Experience with model evaluation, experimentation, prompting, or AI system iteration.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable plans.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions when the right answer is not obvious.

Mindset

  • Highly technical, curious, and comfortable going deep.

  • Strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and learning from real-world usage.

  • Able to challenge engineers and researchers constructively while maintaining strong collaboration.

  • Comfortable operating with significant ownership in a fast-moving, zero-to-one environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.

  • Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.

  • Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling.

  • Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

An engineering background is a strong plus, but what matters most is the ability to reason deeply about both AI systems and product outcomes.

Outcomes

  • Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities.

  • AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.

  • Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty.

  • Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback.

  • Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers and product leaders have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

As Principal Software Engineer, AI Email App, you own the engineering layer that turns AI capability into a reliable product. You will shape the architecture across backend services, APIs, and client applications, while leading a small team of senior engineers.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You stay close to the code, make critical architectural decisions, and ensure the system remains fast, reliable, and coherent as it scales.

What You'll Own

  • Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop.

  • Design reliable systems for AI-powered workflows, including state, orchestration, tool use, retries, fallbacks, and failure handling.

  • Build the APIs and abstractions that connect AI systems to real-world product experiences.

  • Lead a small, senior engineering team and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship.

  • Make high-impact trade-offs across latency, reliability, cost, security, and user experience.

  • Establish strong production foundations: observability, monitoring, testing, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences.

  • Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.

  • Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.

  • Experience building AI-powered products or systems that integrate with modern ML/LLM capabilities.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable working across backend and client platforms, with deep expertise in at least one.

  • A strong bias toward ownership, shipping, and learning from real-world usage.

  • High standards for code quality, reliability, and engineering fundamentals.

Outcomes

  • Production systems are observable, monitored, and stable under real-world load.

  • Decisions consistently balance speed, cost, reliability, and user experience.

  • Features across backend, mobile, and desktop work smoothly and reliably.

  • Latency and reliability improve measurably over time.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

About Phoenix

Founded in 2019, Phoenix is building the most trusted telehealth platform in Canada, making specialist healthcare accessible to every Canadian, wherever they are. Our platform breaks down barriers to care, empowering patients to take control of their health with personalized treatment options and the guidance of licensed providers.

If you thrive where big ideas turn into real impact, you'll fit right in here. We're a team of creative problem-solvers who move deliberately and collaborate in person, because we think the best work happens that way. At Phoenix, you'll find autonomy over your work, people who care about each other's success, and a mission that's making healthcare better for Canadians.

About the Role

We are looking for a remote Bilingual Nurse Practitioner to join the team. We’re setting the bar for asynchronous telemedicine to deliver a better experience for both patients and healthcare providers.

What You’ll Do

  • Deliver Virtual Care with Impact: Review patient-submitted medical histories through our intelligent, graded online platform and determine candidacy for treatment. Most consultations take under 5 minutes to complete.

  • Support and Prescribe: If appropriate, issue prescriptions. If more information is needed, communicate directly with patients via our secure messaging platform.

  • Collaborate Onsite with a Multidisciplinary Team: You’ll play a pivotal role in helping refine clinical workflows, ensuring we’re delivering seamless, high-quality care at scale.

  • Improve Patient & Provider Experience: Work closely with our Customer Experience, Product, and Engineering teams to identify friction points and co-design solutions that elevate healthcare delivery.

  • Lend Your Clinical Expertise to Innovation: Contribute to new product launches and protocols as Phoenix expands into new conditions and offerings.

What We Treat Today

Our current focus includes health conditions such as:

  • Erectile dysfunction

  • Hair loss

  • Weight loss

  • Premature ejaculation

  • Testosterone therapy

Who You Are

  • Bilingual in French and English

  • Registered in good standing with the Ordre des infirmières et infirmiers du Québec (OIIQ), with eligibility for licensure in additional Canadian provinces (support available for the licensing process if needed)

  • Technologically savvy with experience or comfort in digital care platforms.

  • Excellent communicator who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

  • Able to respond to patient needs in a timely and empathetic manner.

  • Passionate about improving the Canadian healthcare landscape.

  • Curious, innovative, and excited to work cross-functionally with non-clinical teams.

  • Previous experience in men’s health is a plus, but not required.

Why this opportunity is exciting

  • Flexible Clinical Work: Patients are privately billed, no insurance paperwork or complex billing systems. The asynchronous nature of our platform means no live appointments with patients via video or phone call.

  • Seamless Technology: Our asynchronous platform was built by engineers who deeply understand provider pain points. It’s designed to support, not slow you down.

  • Innovate at the Frontlines: Your clinical voice will directly inform how we build, improve, and expand our services.

  • No Additional Coverage Needed: You’re already covered through your existing CMPA or equivalent malpractice coverage.

Why Work at Phoenix?

  • A Rewarding Mission: Through our asynchronous care model, Phoenix is reimagining patient-centric care for Canadians across the country by making diagnoses and treatment delivery faster, more accessible, and completely discreet.

  • Impact & Autonomy: You’ll work directly with passionate, experienced leaders who’ve seen the ups and downs of building a business and genuinely care about your growth. You won’t just execute — you’ll help shape the future of Phoenix and Raven.

  • Collaborative On-Site Culture: Our Operations, Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams work together on-site from our downtown Toronto HQ. We thrive on quick feedback loops, spontaneous brainstorms, and actually knowing the people we work with. Bonus points if you're into the occasional foosball tournament or have strong opinions about the best lunch spot nearby.

  • Clinical Excellence: All Phoenix & Raven telehealth clinicians work remotely, providing the highest quality care for even the most sensitive of health topics. Medications are delivered directly (and discreetly) to patients via our pharmacy warehouses, where our diligent Pharmacy team packages each treatment with care.

  • Competitive Pay, Real Benefits: Our compensation bands are backed by real market data, so offers are competitive and fair. Our benefits package includes standard healthcare coverage, a remote-first holiday season, and holistic wellbeing support for when life just happens.

jobs.description:
About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

About the Role

You will own the systems, processes and frameworks that drive performance across the company. You will lead company-wide OKR planning and review cycles, design scalable performance management processes, analyze organizational data, and ensure our culture and values are consistently reflected in how we hire, evaluate and develop people.

You will work closely with leadership across the business to improve execution, increase accountability and help teams perform at their highest level.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own and continuously improve the company's performance management framework.

  • Lead company-wide OKR planning, tracking and quarterly review cycles.

  • Design and implement scalable people processes that improve organizational effectiveness.

  • Analyze people, performance and operational data to identify trends, measure outcomes and recommend improvements.

  • Build dashboards and reports that provide meaningful insights into organizational performance.

  • Define business requirements for HR systems, reporting tools and workflow automation.

  • Partner with leaders across the company to improve team performance and execution.

  • Develop frameworks for performance reviews, calibration, promotions and career development.

  • Drive initiatives that strengthen accountability, ownership and a high-performance culture.

  • Ensure company values are embedded throughout employee programs, performance evaluations and day-to-day operations.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate inefficiencies and improve the employee experience.

  • Support strategic people initiatives and organizational projects as the company grows.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • Experience in People Operations, People Analytics, Organizational Effectiveness, HR Strategy, Business Operations, Management Consulting or a related field.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into action.

  • Experience designing or improving performance management frameworks, OKRs or organizational processes.

  • Excellent problem-solving and structured thinking skills.

  • Ability to write clear business requirements and improve operational workflows.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities.

  • High ownership, attention to detail and a bias toward execution.

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

Through a combination of in-room hardware, AI, and desktop and mobile applications, Teton helps create a seamless healthcare experience for both patients and providers. jobs.excerpt: About the RoleThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
jobs.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Technical Lead, AI Email App, you own the engineering layer that turns AI capability into a reliable product. You will shape the architecture across backend services, APIs, and client applications, while leading a small team of senior engineers.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You stay close to the code, make critical architectural decisions, and ensure the system remains fast, reliable, and coherent as it scales.

What You'll Own

  • Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop.

  • Design reliable systems for AI-powered workflows, including state, orchestration, tool use, retries, fallbacks, and failure handling.

  • Build the APIs and abstractions that connect AI systems to real-world product experiences.

  • Lead a small, senior engineering team and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship.

  • Make high-impact trade-offs across latency, reliability, cost, security, and user experience.

  • Establish strong production foundations: observability, monitoring, testing, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences.

  • Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.

  • Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.

  • Experience building AI-powered products or systems that integrate with modern ML/LLM capabilities.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable working across backend and client platforms, with deep expertise in at least one.

  • A strong bias toward ownership, shipping, and learning from real-world usage.

  • High standards for code quality, reliability, and engineering fundamentals.

Outcomes

  • Production systems are observable, monitored, and stable under real-world load.

  • Decisions consistently balance speed, cost, reliability, and user experience.

  • Features across backend, mobile, and desktop work smoothly and reliably.

  • Latency and reliability improve measurably over time.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

jobs.excerpt: This is a fully remote position.  This is a 100% remote job — you can work remotely from anywhere in the United States.
jobs.description:
This is a fully remote position. This is a 100% remote job — you can work remotely from anywhere in the United States.

About the Role

ShapeScale is hiring our first full-time Founding Sales Rep (Full-Cycle). This is a founding sales role at a ~10-person startup doing $2M+ ARR.

There is no marketing team, no SDR, and no warm lead pool. Your job is to build pipeline from nothing using systematic outbound, then demo, close, and document the playbook so the next hire does not start from zero.

The sale is SMB, not enterprise. Average deal: $3K–$10K ACV. Cycle: under 3 months. You will talk to clinic owners and med-spa operators, not procurement committees. If you are used to six-month enterprise cycles with a legal team and a BANT checklist, this will feel fast and loose. If that excites you, keep reading.

What we need most is somebody who can answer: “If I need to generate $X in revenue in 90 days, how many accounts do I need to touch, how many demos do I need to run, and what is my weekly activity plan to get there?” Then actually do it, in a CRM, with real numbers, not back-of-napkin optimism.

About ShapeScale

ShapeScale builds advanced 3D body scanners for wellness and aesthetic businesses. We help clinics, med-spas, and medical weight-loss practices track body composition and deliver measurable results to their clients.

  • Y Combinator and StartX backed

  • Raised $15M+

  • $2M+ annual recurring revenue

  • ~10 employees

  • Featured in TechCrunch, Forbes, Wired

What You Will Actually Do (first 90 days)

  • Build target account lists from scratch using industry directories, competitor mapping, association memberships, and any creative channel that works. Many of our prospects are not on LinkedIn, so you will need to get resourceful.

  • Design and run multi-channel outbound campaigns: cold calls (a huge plus in our industry), cold email, LinkedIn, Instagram DMs, SMS, direct mail, industry events, network and referral sourcing. Not just one channel.

  • Own your numbers: set weekly targets for outreach volume, demo rate, and close rate; track them in CRM; adjust when reality disagrees with the plan.

  • Run a disciplined CRM cadence (Attio) with stage definitions, activity history, and forecast accuracy. No dropped leads, no guesswork.

  • Conduct demos and own full-cycle close on $3K–$10K deals.

  • Document what works: ICP criteria, scripts, cadences, objection handlers — so this is repeatable.

  • Partner directly with the founders on sales strategy, messaging, and market feedback.

  • Attend 2–3 trade shows per quarter (domestic, possibly international travel).

What You Need to Have Done Before

  • 3–5+ years in B2B sales where you personally sourced at least 50% of your own pipeline

  • Experience selling to SMBs with deal sizes in the $3K–$20K range and cycles under 3 months

  • Quantitative pipeline ownership: you can work backwards from a revenue target to a weekly activity plan and explain your conversion assumptions

  • Multi-channel sourcing experience. Cold calling is a big plus. Instagram DMs, network/referrals, texting, events, partnership referrals, creative channels. If you only know email and LinkedIn InMails, we are not interested.

  • CRM discipline: you maintain a clean pipeline with stage definitions, activity history, and forecast accuracy — and you can show it

  • Comfort with sales automation and prospecting tools (, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, or equivalent)

  • Experience closing deals end-to-end, not just qualifying or setting meetings

  • Startup or small-team experience where you did not have a marketing team or SDR pool to feed you

Preferred

  • Experience selling to small businesses in wellness, fitness, beauty, aesthetics, med-spa, or related consumer-facing services

  • Existing network in aesthetics, med-spa, or clinic operations (bonus, not required)

  • Experience with Attio, ActiveCampaign, or similar modern CRMs

  • Comfortable with AI-powered sales tools: OpenClaw, Claude Cowork, Clay, Codex, or similar

This is NOT the role for you if

  • Your last two jobs gave you a book of business or warm leads to work

  • You prefer relationship selling and networking over systematic outbound

  • You have never personally built a target list from scratch

  • You rely on one channel and have not experimented with others

  • You think “hustle” is a strategy instead of a process you can describe step by step

  • You cannot walk us through your last 30-day outreach report with real numbers

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base salary: $80,000

  • On-Target Earnings: $120,000–$140,000 at plan

  • High performers: $200,000+

  • Uncapped commission

  • Equity: 1.5% founding equity (4-year vesting, 1-year cliff)

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Fully remote, United States only

  • Direct founder collaboration and real ownership over the first repeatable outbound sales motion

Comp context: In medical aesthetic device sales, many roles are 1099 with no base. We offer W2 stability plus equity, which is rare in this industry.

Our Interview Process

  1. Phone screen — fit and outbound experience

  2. Skills interview — live role-play, pipeline math, and outbound system design

  3. Demo interview — run a real ShapeScale demo

  4. Founder debrief — reference checks and offer

We move fast. If you are a builder who wants real ownership, apply below.

Compensation Range: $120K - $200K

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
jobs.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you own the execution layer of our intelligence, turning research and model capabilities into reliable, scalable production systems.

You will work across the model lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, inference, and deployment. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who wants to operate at the intersection of research, systems, and product.

What You'll Own

  • Own the end-to-end ML systems powering our company, from data and training to evaluation, inference, and deployment.

  • Build and evolve training and fine-tuning pipelines for large models.

  • Design evaluation systems that measure capability, robustness, safety, and real-world product performance.

  • Architect high-performance inference systems, optimizing latency, GPU utilization, memory, cost, and reliability.

  • Build data pipelines and systems for high-quality real-world and synthetic training data.

  • Establish reliable production infrastructure for deploying, monitoring, and continuously improving models.

  • Partner closely with research and application engineering to turn model capabilities into product improvements.

  • Make pragmatic technical trade-offs and rapidly iterate based on real-world performance.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience building and shipping ML systems used in production, not just research prototypes.

  • Strong understanding of modern large-model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and inference.

  • Strong software engineering and systems fundamentals.

  • Experience operating ML workloads at meaningful scale, particularly GPU-based systems.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguous problems independently.

  • A bias toward experimentation, measurement, and shipping.

  • High standards for correctness, reliability, and production quality.

Outcomes

  • Research and models reliably translate into production-ready solutions with clear performance and quality targets.

  • ML pipelines, training loops, and inference systems are stable, efficient, and maintainable.

  • Production issues are detected, debugged, and resolved quickly, minimizing user impact.

  • Team members are supported, aligned, and able to deliver high-impact ML work with minimal friction.

  • Iterations on models and systems are measurable, safe, and improve user experience over time.

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • PyTorch / JAX

  • GPU-based training and inference system

Ideal Experience

  • You have built or shipped real ML systems used by people, not just demos.

  • You are comfortable working with large models and understanding their failure modes.

  • You write strong, production-grade code and care about system correctness.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

We are looking for a remote Bilingual Nurse Practitioner to join the team. We’re setting the bar for asynchronous telemedicine to deliver a better experience for both patients and healthcare providers.

What You’ll Do

  • Deliver Virtual Care with Impact: Review patient-submitted medical histories through our intelligent, graded online platform and determine candidacy for treatment. Most consultations take under 5 minutes to complete.

What We Treat Today

Our current focus includes health conditions such as:

  • Weight loss

  • Premature ejaculation

  • Testosterone therapy

Who You Are

  • Excellent communicator who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
