jobs.title: Head of Sales
jobs.excerpt: Stora is looking for a Head of Sales to take ownership of the sales function as the business moves into its next stage of growth.
jobs.description:
Stora is looking for a Head of Sales to take ownership of the sales function as the business moves into its next stage of growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role, not a manage-from-the-sidelines one.

There is already a product customers want, an established position in the UK and Ireland, growing European opportunity, and a sales team in place. The challenge now is to turn that foundation into a more predictable, repeatable commercial engine.

You’ll work directly with the CEO, lead SDRs and Account Executives, improve how pipeline is created and converted, and bring greater clarity to forecasting, performance and where the next growth opportunities sit.

The opportunity

Stora has grown quickly, but the next stage requires more than simply doing more of what worked before.

The Head of Sales will be expected to answer questions like:

  • Where should the team focus its time and why?

  • How does outbound become consistently productive?

  • Where are deals getting stuck?

  • How should SDRs and AEs be coached and developed?

  • Which segments and markets represent the strongest opportunities?

  • What needs to change in the sales motion as Stora moves upmarket and expands internationally?

  • How does the business build a forecast leadership can genuinely rely on?

This is a role with real authority to improve things, alongside accountability for the results.

What you’ll own

  • Sales strategy and execution

  • Leadership, coaching and development of the SDR and AE team

  • Outbound performance and pipeline generation

  • Sales process from first engagement through to closed-won

  • Forecasting, pipeline health and revenue visibility

  • Performance management and clear expectations across the team

  • Key and strategically important opportunities where senior involvement can make a difference

  • Close alignment with Marketing and Product around ICP, messaging, customer insight and market opportunity

You’ll also stay close to customers and deals.

Stora wants a sales leader who knows what is happening on the ground, not someone whose understanding of the market comes entirely from dashboards and weekly reports.

What a strong candidate looks like

Stora needs a hands-on B2B SaaS sales leader who can build consistent performance, not just manage what already exists.

You’re likely someone who:

  • Has a genuine hunter mentality and knows how to create pipeline, not just manage what lands

  • Has led and developed SaaS sales teams and can raise the standard of performance around them

  • Knows what good outbound looks like and can coach it properly

  • Has personally sold into SMB and/or mid-market customers and can still step into important deals when needed

  • Builds healthier, more predictable pipeline and brings strong forecasting discipline

  • Qualifies hard, prioritises well and is comfortable walking away from weak opportunities

  • Uses data to improve decisions without hiding behind dashboards

  • Challenges assumptions, spots where the sales motion is weak and acts on it

  • Sets clear expectations, coaches directly and holds people accountable

  • Can move comfortably between commercial strategy with the CEO, coaching the team and getting involved in a deal that matters

  • Has the commercial instinct to spot new segments, markets or opportunities worth pursuing

This is still a stage where leadership means building as well as leading. If you want to inherit a large sales organisation, established territories and a finished playbook, this probably is not the role.

Experience in vertical SaaS, operationally complex industries or international markets would be useful, but none are essential.

Why Stora

Stora builds the software self storage operators use to run and grow their businesses, covering areas including bookings, payments, facility management, reporting and automation.

The business has established strong traction in the UK and Ireland and is continuing to expand across Europe and other international markets.

For a Head of Sales, that creates an interesting point to join:

  • A proven product rather than an early experiment

  • Existing customers and market credibility

  • A sales team already in place

  • Significant European market opportunity ahead

  • Direct access to the CEO and leadership team

  • The ability to meaningfully shape commercial strategy

  • Share options and genuine participation in the upside created

The foundations exist. The opportunity is to build what comes next.

Location

Stora operates as a distributed business across the UK and Europe.

Being based in Northern Ireland would be particularly useful given the proximity to the CEO and leadership team, although strong candidates elsewhere in the UK or EU will absolutely be considered.

What Stora offers

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission plan

  • Share options

  • 35 days annual leave

  • Private health insurance for you and your family

  • Company pension

  • Apple hardware

  • Work from home budget

  • Learning and development support

  • Regular in-person team events and company meet-ups

Next steps

Applications are reviewed as they come in and Stora will move quickly where there is a strong fit.

Equal opportunities

Stora is committed to creating a workplace where people are treated fairly, with dignity and respect.

Applications are welcomed from suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religious belief or political opinion, or sexual orientation.

Recruitment decisions are based on merit, capability and business need.

If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let the team know.

jobs.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Product Owner, AI Email App, you work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and engineering constraints. You will work directly with ML and engineering teams to define how the system should behave, how we measure it, and how we continuously improve it.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You are expected to understand the system and challenge technical decisions.

What You'll Own

  • Define end-to-end requirements for AI capabilities, from model behavior to system behavior to user experience.

  • Translate model capabilities, evaluation results, and technical constraints into clear product and system decisions.

  • Make trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and UX.

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and client engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration.

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback.

  • Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences.

  • Drive execution through clear specifications, prioritization, and strong technical judgment.

  • Identify failure modes and ensure AI systems behave predictably and recover gracefully.

  • Own product quality end-to-end, correctness, reliability, usefulness, and user trust.

What We're Looking For

Technical

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills.

  • Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production.

  • Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers.

  • Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, and failure modes.

Product & AI

  • Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered products, particularly LLM-based systems.

  • Experience with model evaluation, experimentation, prompting, or AI system iteration.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable plans.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions when the right answer is not obvious.

Mindset

  • Highly technical, curious, and comfortable going deep.

  • Strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and learning from real-world usage.

  • Able to challenge engineers and researchers constructively while maintaining strong collaboration.

  • Comfortable operating with significant ownership in a fast-moving, zero-to-one environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.

  • Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.

  • Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling.

  • Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

An engineering background is a strong plus, but what matters most is the ability to reason deeply about both AI systems and product outcomes.

Outcomes

  • Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities.

  • AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.

  • Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty.

  • Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback.

  • Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers and product leaders have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
jobs.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Product Owner, AI Email App, you work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and engineering constraints. You will work directly with ML and engineering teams to define how the system should behave, how we measure it, and how we continuously improve it.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You are expected to understand the system and challenge technical decisions.

What You'll Own

  • Define end-to-end requirements for AI capabilities, from model behavior to system behavior to user experience.

  • Translate model capabilities, evaluation results, and technical constraints into clear product and system decisions.

  • Make trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and UX.

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and client engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration.

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback.

  • Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences.

  • Drive execution through clear specifications, prioritization, and strong technical judgment.

  • Identify failure modes and ensure AI systems behave predictably and recover gracefully.

  • Own product quality end-to-end, correctness, reliability, usefulness, and user trust.

What We're Looking For

Technical

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills.

  • Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production.

  • Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers.

  • Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, and failure modes.

Product & AI

  • Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered products, particularly LLM-based systems.

  • Experience with model evaluation, experimentation, prompting, or AI system iteration.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable plans.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions when the right answer is not obvious.

Mindset

  • Highly technical, curious, and comfortable going deep.

  • Strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and learning from real-world usage.

  • Able to challenge engineers and researchers constructively while maintaining strong collaboration.

  • Comfortable operating with significant ownership in a fast-moving, zero-to-one environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.

  • Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.

  • Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling.

  • Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

An engineering background is a strong plus, but what matters most is the ability to reason deeply about both AI systems and product outcomes.

Outcomes

  • Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities.

  • AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.

  • Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty.

  • Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback.

  • Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers and product leaders have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

jobs.description:
Peek is the operating system powering the experiences industry - from museums and attractions to tours and activities. With over $7B in bookings, Peek’s AI-powered platform has helped thousands of merchants to increase revenues, save time, and deliver seamless guest experiences. Customers include MoMA, Whitney Museum, Seattle Aquarium, Bryant Park & Looping Group. The company has raised over $150 million from institutional investors Westcap, Goldman Sachs, and SpringCoast Partners. Learn more at .

As a remote-first company recognized by Forbes as one of America's Best Startup Employers and by Built In as a 2025 and 2026 Best Place to Work, we are a global team of "Peeksters" who "Obsess Over Our Customers," "Accomplish Big Things," "Collaborate With Purpose," and "Get Better Every Day.

About the Role

Peek is looking for a product-minded, data-driven, and growth-oriented Data Analyst – BI and AI to turn data into meaningful insights, reporting, and data-driven improvements. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of business intelligence and the exciting new frontier of AI-enabled analytics, supporting Product, Operations, Marketing, and Leadership with high-impact insights.

You’ll help shape Peek’s analytics ecosystem by building dashboards, analyzing customer behaviors, identifying friction in key flows, and experimenting with AI tools to enhance how our teams interact with data. You do not need to be an ML engineer or train models from scratch. You should, however, be comfortable using AI tools thoughtfully, evaluating their output, and helping turn promising use cases into practical workflows.

What You’ll Do

1. Business Intelligence, Reporting & Insights

  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards and analytic tools using BI platforms such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.

  • Partner with teams across Product, Operations, Marketing, and Finance to deliver data insights that drive business decisions.

  • Analyze customer and user behavior patterns within core product flows (activation, conversion, engagement, retention) to support product and business decisions.

  • Surface opportunities by evaluating funnels, drop-off points, friction patterns, and adoption trends.

  • Contribute to metric definition and performance tracking for new features, enhancements, and business initiatives.

  • Automate recurring reporting and data workflows using SQL, DBT, and lightweight scripting (Python or Apps Script).

  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across reporting pipelines.

  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that inform strategy and improve customer experience.

2. AI-Driven Analytics & Innovation

  • Use modern AI tools and APIs (such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or comparable platforms) to accelerate analysis, improve stakeholder self-service, and automate repeatable analytics workflows.

  • Help design and evaluate practical AI-enabled internal tools, such as natural-language data exploration, automated insight summaries, data-quality checks, opportunity identification, and workflow-routing solutions.

  • Partner with the Data, AI, Strategy, and Yield team to identify high-value business problems where AI can improve decision speed, reduce manual work, or uncover revenue and product opportunities.

  • Measure the effectiveness of AI-enabled workflows using clear adoption, quality, efficiency, and business-impact metrics.

  • Apply sound judgment around data privacy, accuracy, and human review; validate AI-generated insights before they inform decisions.

What You Bring

  • 1–4 years of experience in Business Intelligence or Data Analytics within a SaaS or tech environment.

  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with a cloud data warehouse, ideally BigQuery.

  • Experience building governed, self-serve reporting in Looker, Sigma, Tableau, or Power BI

  • Solid understanding of data visualization, dashboard design, and storytelling principles.

  • Familiarity with key product-related metrics such as activation, retention, churn, funnels, and engagement.

  • Strong communication skills — able to bridge technical analysis with business context.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous business questions into structured analyses, clear recommendations, and measurable next steps.

Nice to Have

  • Working knowledge of Python, R, or Google Apps Script for data manipulation and automation (a plus, not required).

  • Familiarity with dbt, data modeling, testing, and metric-definition practices.

  • Interest in travel tech or SaaS analytics environments.

  • Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences.

  • Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale.

  • Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.

  • Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.

  • Features across backend, mobile, and desktop work smoothly and reliably.

This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Product Lead, AI Email App, you work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and engineering constraints. You will work directly with ML and engineering teams to define how the system should behave, how we measure it, and how we continuously improve it.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You are expected to understand the system and challenge technical decisions.

What You'll Own

  • Define end-to-end requirements for AI capabilities, from model behavior to system behavior to user experience.

  • Translate model capabilities, evaluation results, and technical constraints into clear product and system decisions.

  • Make trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and UX.

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and client engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration.

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback.

  • Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences.

  • Drive execution through clear specifications, prioritization, and strong technical judgment.

  • Identify failure modes and ensure AI systems behave predictably and recover gracefully.

  • Own product quality end-to-end, correctness, reliability, usefulness, and user trust.

What We're Looking For

Technical

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills.

  • Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production.

  • Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers.

  • Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, and failure modes.

Product & AI

  • Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered products, particularly LLM-based systems.

  • Experience with model evaluation, experimentation, prompting, or AI system iteration.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable plans.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions when the right answer is not obvious.

Mindset

  • Highly technical, curious, and comfortable going deep.

  • Strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and learning from real-world usage.

  • Able to challenge engineers and researchers constructively while maintaining strong collaboration.

  • Comfortable operating with significant ownership in a fast-moving, zero-to-one environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.

  • Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.

  • Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling.

  • Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

An engineering background is a strong plus, but what matters most is the ability to reason deeply about both AI systems and product outcomes.

Outcomes

  • Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities.

  • AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.

  • Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty.

  • Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback.

  • Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction.

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers and product leaders have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

jobs.title: Product Manager (Senior / Staff)
jobs.excerpt: PermitFlow is redefining how America builds.  We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how.
jobs.description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

Building the AI Infrastructure for Construction

  • Construction is one of the largest industries in the world - and one of the most operationally fragmented.

  • Before anything gets built, projects must move through permitting and pre-construction workflows spread across ~20,000 jurisdictions, each with different rules, systems, and processes.

  • The result is a massive bottleneck slowing down housing and infrastructure across the country.

  • PermitFlow is rebuilding this layer from the ground up - using modern software and AI systems to automate and orchestrate permitting end-to-end.

  • We are still early. The product surface area is expanding rapidly, the workflows are deeply complex, and the opportunity to shape how this industry operates is enormous.

  • This is one of those rare moments where product decisions directly influence how the physical world gets built.

Location

  • Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in-office days per week).

Role Overview

  • We’re hiring a Product Manager to lead critical product initiatives across PermitFlow’s platform.

  • This is a highly ownership-driven role at the intersection of AI, workflow automation, and real-world operational complexity. You’ll work directly with engineering, design, operations, leadership, and customers to define products that simplify one of the most fragmented workflows in the physical economy.

  • The best PMs here operate like builders and owners. They move quickly, prioritize ruthlessly, stay close to customers, and drive clarity in ambiguous environments.

  • You will own problems end-to-end from customer discovery and product strategy through execution, launch, iteration, and measurable customer impact.

  • This is not a role where you inherit a fully-defined roadmap. You’ll help define what gets built, why it matters, and how the product evolves as the company scales.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead a core product area focused on customer-facing workflows and AI-powered systems that simplify complex permitting processes

  • Drive the full product lifecycle: discovery, prioritization, design, development, launch, and iteration

  • Work directly with customers to deeply understand pain points, operational bottlenecks, and workflow inefficiencies

  • Translate ambiguous real-world problems into intuitive, scalable product experiences

  • Partner closely with engineering, design, operations, and sales to deliver products that create measurable customer and business impact

  • Define product strategy, roadmap priorities, success metrics, and execution plans across teams

  • Drive alignment across leadership and cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-moving environment

  • Help establish product standards, operating principles, and execution culture as the PM organization scales

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for product leaders who thrive in high-ownership environments and enjoy solving operationally complex problems.

  • 3+ years of product management experience shipping impactful products in startups or fast-moving environments

  • Strong product judgment and ability to prioritize effectively across competing opportunities

  • Experience leading product initiatives with meaningful business or customer impact

  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and create clarity for cross-functional teams

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across engineering, leadership, operations, and customers

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability with a customer-first mindset

  • Technical fluency and comfort working closely with engineering teams

  • High sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability

  • Bonus: experience with workflow systems, AI products, enterprise SaaS, or operational tooling

Why This Role Matters

This is not a feature optimization role - it is a systems-building role inside a category being created in real time.

PermitFlow sits at the intersection of:

  • fragmented real-world regulatory infrastructure

  • high-friction operational workflows

  • and emerging AI systems capable of automating end-to-end complexity

The products built here directly impact how quickly housing and infrastructure projects move from idea to execution.

This role offers rare leverage: you’ll help define both the product experience and the operational foundation of a rapidly scaling company still early enough for individual decisions to meaningfully shape its trajectory.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • 401(k) savings plan

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

  • Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided

  • Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

Closing

If you’re excited by the opportunity to build AI-powered products that simplify complex real-world workflows - and want to help define a category from the ground up - we’d love to talk.

Inside PermitFlow: The Team Transforming Construction Permitting

PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or family status, as protected by applicable law.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Compensation Range: $160K - $270K

The Role

BJAK builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Staff Software Engineer owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

What You'll Own

  • Translate model capabilities, evaluation results, and technical constraints into clear product and system decisions.

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and client engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration.

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback.

  • Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences.

What We're Looking For

Technical

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills.

  • Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production.

  • Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers.

  • Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, and failure modes.

Product & AI

  • Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered products, particularly LLM-based systems.

  • Experience with model evaluation, experimentation, prompting, or AI system iteration.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable plans.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions when the right answer is not obvious.

Mindset

  • Strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and learning from real-world usage.

  • Comfortable operating with significant ownership in a fast-moving, zero-to-one environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.

  • Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.

  • Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling.

  • Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

An engineering background is a strong plus, but what matters most is the ability to reason deeply about both AI systems and product outcomes.

Outcomes

  • AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.

jobs.title: Product Owner, AI Email App
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
jobs.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Product Owner, AI Email App, you work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and engineering constraints. You will work directly with ML and engineering teams to define how the system should behave, how we measure it, and how we continuously improve it.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You are expected to understand the system and challenge technical decisions.

What You'll Own

  • Define end-to-end requirements for AI capabilities, from model behavior to system behavior to user experience.

  • Translate model capabilities, evaluation results, and technical constraints into clear product and system decisions.

  • Make trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and UX.

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and client engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration.

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback.

  • Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences.

  • Drive execution through clear specifications, prioritization, and strong technical judgment.

  • Identify failure modes and ensure AI systems behave predictably and recover gracefully.

  • Own product quality end-to-end, correctness, reliability, usefulness, and user trust.

What We're Looking For

Technical

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills.

  • Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production.

  • Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers.

  • Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, and failure modes.

Product & AI

  • Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered products, particularly LLM-based systems.

  • Experience with model evaluation, experimentation, prompting, or AI system iteration.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable plans.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions when the right answer is not obvious.

Mindset

  • Highly technical, curious, and comfortable going deep.

  • Strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and learning from real-world usage.

  • Able to challenge engineers and researchers constructively while maintaining strong collaboration.

  • Comfortable operating with significant ownership in a fast-moving, zero-to-one environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.

  • Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.

  • Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling.

  • Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

An engineering background is a strong plus, but what matters most is the ability to reason deeply about both AI systems and product outcomes.

Outcomes

  • Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities.

  • AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.

  • Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty.

  • Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback.

  • Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers and product leaders have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

We're running a paid study on the usability of a new user research platform designed for product teams. This research will help refine the core interface and workflow before broader rollout. Your insights will directly influence how research tools support daily product decisions.

You will join a remote video call for a brief, think-aloud usability session. We will show you early prototypes of the platform and ask you to navigate specific workflows. jobs.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Technical Lead, AI Email App, you own the engineering layer that turns AI capability into a reliable product. You will shape the architecture across backend services, APIs, and client applications, while leading a small team of senior engineers.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You stay close to the code, make critical architectural decisions, and ensure the system remains fast, reliable, and coherent as it scales.

What You'll Own

  • Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop.

  • Design reliable systems for AI-powered workflows, including state, orchestration, tool use, retries, fallbacks, and failure handling.

  • Build the APIs and abstractions that connect AI systems to real-world product experiences.

  • Lead a small, senior engineering team and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship.

  • Make high-impact trade-offs across latency, reliability, cost, security, and user experience.

  • Establish strong production foundations: observability, monitoring, testing, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences.

  • Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.

  • Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.

  • Experience building AI-powered products or systems that integrate with modern ML/LLM capabilities.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable working across backend and client platforms, with deep expertise in at least one.

  • A strong bias toward ownership, shipping, and learning from real-world usage.

  • High standards for code quality, reliability, and engineering fundamentals.

Outcomes

  • Production systems are observable, monitored, and stable under real-world load.

  • Decisions consistently balance speed, cost, reliability, and user experience.

  • Features across backend, mobile, and desktop work smoothly and reliably.

  • Latency and reliability improve measurably over time.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

jobs.title: Senior AI Systems Architect
jobs.excerpt: Why you should join us? • Join a YC-backed, profitable Series C startup with capital with 5M+ customers • Own the AI systems layer of a consumer product used by millions — LLMs, agents, and internal APIs applied to a fragmented $2T market.
jobs.description:
Why you should join us?

  • Join a YC-backed, profitable Series C startup with capital with 5M+ customers

  • Own the AI systems layer of a consumer product used by millions — LLMs, agents, and internal APIs applied to a fragmented $2T market.

  • Work with partners like OpenAI to integrate Jerry.ai services directly into the ChatGPT App and pioneer new model capabilities.

  • Flat org, ambitious goals, and a direct line to the founders and execs.

The technical challenge:

The interesting problems aren't in the prompt anymore. They're in the system around it: what the agents are allowed to do, how the pieces fit together, where the guardrails go, and what 'correct' even means when the output isn't deterministic.

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with the car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat) and accelerating our growth.

Before off-the-shelf platforms existed, we built our own infrastructure to automate sales and service conversations. That system now handles over 70% of inbound sales and service requests: more than 50,000 chats a month, in production, at scale.

That head start gave us real leverage, and it's outgrown ad hoc ownership. We need someone who can run a fast-moving, high-volume chatbot operation day to day and has a real point of view on the next bets: voicebot, computer use, consumer AI applications.

What you'll actually do:

  • Decide what we build next in AI, and make the case for it. Nobody hands you a roadmap.

  • Partner with OpenAI to evaluate and deploy next-generation voice models and workflow automation.

  • Evaluate emerging AI technology (voicebot, computer use agents, and beyond), prototype what's worth building, and make the call on what we invest in next.

  • Design evaluation frameworks and guardrails, and make the real tradeoffs between latency, cost, and accuracy in a regulated production environment.

  • Set the technical bar for our chatbot systems — shape what the prompt engineering team builds next and keep the architecture sound as it scales.

  • Build new automations across areas like record disputes, email/callout reduction, document validation (ex. licenses, proof of insurance).

  • Work directly with subject matter experts to turn domain knowledge into systems that behave correctly.

Ideal experience:

  • 5+ years in a product engineering or forward deployed engineering, ideally in an early stage startup

  • A track record of turning ambiguous problems into systems that actually run

  • Hands-on experience putting LLM-based systems into production, including the unglamorous parts: evals, regressions, latency, cost, and failure handling

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

Jerry.ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, reproductive health decisions or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other characteristics protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.

Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed on this job posting, determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.

About Jerry.ai

Your car and your home are your most expensive assets. And for most people, these aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair or, worse, an accident, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

Jerry is building the first AI agent to manage all your physical assets. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and have been profitable since 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

We’re fully remote with offices in Palo Alto, New York, Chicago, and Toronto.

Compensation Range: $160K - $210K

jobs.description:
Based in Washington, D.C., Quorum is the leading provider of workflow software and information services for government affairs professionals globally. We serve over 2,000 customers—including over 50% of the Fortune 100—across 30+ countries.

At Quorum, our "product" isn't just our software; it’s our people. We are looking for a 100% remote AI GTM Systems Specialist who is a hands-on builder, systems thinker, and revenue growth driver. This isn't just an ops role—it’s an opportunity to shape how artificial intelligence powers the entire customer journey across our global Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy.

The Impact You’ll Have

As an AI GTM Systems Specialist, reporting directly to the Sr. Director of Demand Generation and Marketing Operations, you are the technical engine bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI capabilities and real-world revenue execution. You will design, deploy, and optimize agentic workflows that drive pipeline velocity—from account research and personalized outbound execution to CRM synchronization and deal support. By turning GTM friction into automated, high-performing AI solutions, you will directly influence Quorum’s scalable growth and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Agentic Workflow Architecture: Build and maintain intelligent AI agents across the entire customer lifecycle, including campaign ideation, audience discovery, competitive intelligence, and account-based sales support.

  • AI SDR Outbound Motion: Support day-to-day outbound execution—managing prospect list generation, waterfall enrichment (via Clay or equivalent platforms), sequencing, reply management, and seamless meeting hand-offs to Account Executives.

  • AI Infrastructure & Tooling: Design prompt templates, tool definitions, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines over internal content libraries and CRM data using frameworks like Claude Code, the Claude Agent SDK, and MCP connectors.

  • Production Operations & Guardrails: Implement safety protocols, PII protection, and content filtering; track token usage, latency, and costs; and monitor sending infrastructure (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) to guarantee high deliverability and regulatory compliance (CAN-SPAM/GDPR).

  • Measurable Revenue Impact: Run performance experiments (A/B testing on prompts/workflows) and track core metrics—such as pipeline generated, meetings booked/held, time-to-first-touch, and AE time saved—to continuously optimize system outputs.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner directly with frontline Sales, Marketing, and CS teams to translate operational pain points into clear AI initiatives, leading pilot programs and creating user enablement documentation.

About You

  • The Experienced Builder: You bring 1–3 years of hands-on experience building or operating AI/ML applications and LLM agentic workflows, coupled with 1–5 years in RevOps, Marketing Ops, or Sales Ops within a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Technical & Tooling Savvy: You are proficient with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI), prompt engineering, basic Python, Clay, webhooks, and modern automation tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, Salesforce, Marketo). You are comfortable working with tools like Claude Code and MCP connectors.

  • Data-Driven & Systems-Minded: You understand email deliverability dynamics, compliance standards, and how to measure ROI through concrete KPIs like conversion rates, deliverability health, and pipeline creation.

  • Collaborative Communicator: You excel at translating complex, technical AI concepts for non-technical stakeholders, gathering user requirements, and turning frontline feedback into actionable system enhancements.

  • Agile Learner: You thrive in a fast-paced environment, master new agentic frameworks quickly, and are excited to grow your technical depth on the job.About the Marketing Team

About the Marketing Team

We’re responsible for ensuring that clients have an amazing experience with Quorum.

  • We are Growth Drivers: We build data-driven paths to revenue, ensuring our sales partners are equipped with highly engaged, qualified enterprise opportunities.

  • We are Innovators: We experiment constantly with the latest technologies, from predictive intent tools to AI automation, staying ahead of B2B marketing trends.

  • We are Scalable Creators: We bridge the gap between creative storytelling and analytical precision, delivering targeted experiences that matter to our audiences.

  • We are a Community: We thrive on cross-functional alignment and mutual support. We work closely across sales and marketing lines, celebrating wins together, solving challenges creatively, and driving company growth as a unified front.

Our Work Environment

  • We are an AI-forward team—AI is built into how we work, think, and grow.

  • We are a remote-friendly team with flexible work options: work remotely or, if you're in the area, choose to visit our vibrant, sunlit space in our modern, open-concept office in Washington, D.C.

  • Our office building is located in the heart of downtown DC, easily accessible by metro, bus, and rideshares. It is also in close proximity to great restaurants, food trucks, shopping, and popular happy hour spots.

Benefits

  • Flexible Paid Time Off

  • Paid Company holidays plus additional company-wide days off for team members to rest and recharge

  • Four Day Weekends for President’s Day, Memorial Day, and Labor Day

  • Free Subscription to LinkedIn Learning to support professional development

  • Invest in Yourself Days - one designated day per quarter dedicated to your professional development!

  • Work from Home Reimbursement for home office support

  • 401k match

  • Health & Financial Wellbeing support

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plan options

  • Virtual and in-person team events

  • Community groups open to all team members

  • Paid 12 weeks off for parental leave

Compensation

  • On target earnings starting at $120,000, increasing based on experience

  • This is a full-time remote position, Exempt - not eligible for overtime.

Our Commitment to Pay Transparency: What Does That Mean For You?

  • We will not ask you what you are currently earning.

  • We will consider years of relevant experience, relevant professional certifications/education, and performance expectations in setting what we believe is a competitive, fair base salary offer.

  • We will be transparent about our compensation structure so that all candidates have equal access to compensation information and can make an informed decision about whether or not Quorum is the right workplace for them.

We comply with all requirements for US government federal contractors issued by the OFCCP, IFR, and the terms of our government contracts.

EEO/AA/F/M/Vet/Disabled

We are currently hiring for this position in the following states: DC, FL, GA, IL, LA, ME, MD, MA, MI, MO, NE, NJ, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, VT, VA, WV.

AI Disclosure:

At Quorum, we utilize modern talent acquisition tools, including our Applicant Tracking System, Ashby, to assist our recruiting team. We use AI-assisted features solely to help us search our database, sort information, personalize our email outreach, and support interview note-taking (candidates have the option to opt out). We do not use automated tools or algorithms to screen out, rank, or make final selection or rejection decisions regarding your application. All hiring decisions are made entirely by human recruiters and hiring managers.

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead, AI Email App
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
jobs.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Technical Product Lead, AI Email App, you work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and engineering constraints. You will work directly with ML and engineering teams to define how the system should behave, how we measure it, and how we continuously improve it.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You are expected to understand the system and challenge technical decisions.

What You'll Own

  • Define end-to-end requirements for AI capabilities, from model behavior to system behavior to user experience.

  • Translate model capabilities, evaluation results, and technical constraints into clear product and system decisions.

  • Make trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and UX.

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and client engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration.

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback.

  • Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences.

  • Drive execution through clear specifications, prioritization, and strong technical judgment.

  • Identify failure modes and ensure AI systems behave predictably and recover gracefully.

  • Own product quality end-to-end, correctness, reliability, usefulness, and user trust.

What We're Looking For

Technical

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills.

  • Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production.

  • Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers.

  • Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, and failure modes.

Product & AI

  • Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered products, particularly LLM-based systems.

  • Experience with model evaluation, experimentation, prompting, or AI system iteration.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable plans.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions when the right answer is not obvious.

Mindset

  • Highly technical, curious, and comfortable going deep.

  • Strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and learning from real-world usage.

  • Able to challenge engineers and researchers constructively while maintaining strong collaboration.

  • Comfortable operating with significant ownership in a fast-moving, zero-to-one environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.

  • Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.

  • Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling.

  • Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

An engineering background is a strong plus, but what matters most is the ability to reason deeply about both AI systems and product outcomes.

Outcomes

  • Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities.

  • AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.

  • Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty.

  • Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback.

  • Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers and product leaders have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Lead Software Engineer, AI Email Apps, you own the engineering layer that turns AI capability into a reliable product. You will shape the architecture across backend services, APIs, and client applications, while leading a small team of senior engineers.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You stay close to the code, make critical architectural decisions, and ensure the system remains fast, reliable, and coherent as it scales.

What You'll Own

  • Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop.

  • Design reliable systems for AI-powered workflows, including state, orchestration, tool use, retries, fallbacks, and failure handling.

  • Build the APIs and abstractions that connect AI systems to real-world product experiences.

  • Lead a small, senior engineering team and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship.

  • Make high-impact trade-offs across latency, reliability, cost, security, and user experience.

  • Establish strong production foundations: observability, monitoring, testing, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences.

  • Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale.

What We're Looking For

jobs.description:
What We're Researching

We're running a paid study on how clinical providers approach medication selection and therapeutic recommendations. Understanding the factors that drive prescribing choices helps us map the real-world workflow of modern patient care. This research aims to identify the clinical, logistical, and patient-specific variables that influence treatment paths.

How It Works

During a remote video session, you will participate in a moderated conversation about your clinical workflow. We will ask you to walk through recent examples of how you evaluate different medication options for your patients. You will review a series of hypothetical patient scenarios and explain your reasoning for recommending specific treatments. Finally, you will provide feedback on the primary challenges you face when ordering or prescribing therapies.

Who This Is For

We are looking for US-based physicians and healthcare professionals with active prescribing authority. We welcome attendings, nurse practitioners, physician assistants, and clinical specialists who regularly make medication recommendations. Ideal candidates will have hands-on experience navigating treatment selection and ordering therapies within the past year.

What You'll Do

  • Walk us through your current workflow for evaluating and selecting patient medications

  • Discuss the primary factors that influence your clinical recommendations

  • Review hypothetical patient scenarios and explain your treatment choices

  • Share insights on the challenges associated with prescribing and ordering therapies

Who Should Apply

  • Active US-based physician or healthcare professional

  • Current authority or influence over medication selection and prescribing

  • Recent clinical experience ordering therapies or making treatment recommendations

  • Comfortable discussing patient care workflows in a remote video setting

$175 one-time

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The role

As an Account Manager, you build your own portfolio of business owners and help them navigate their financial journey with iwoca. Your work directly contributes to the financial success of iwoca and the customer experience. From independent hair salons to established dental practices, you will ensure our customers feel supported, heard, and empowered to grow.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Demonstrates curiosity to use and learn more about AI tools. You’ll already be comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to help solve problems, increase productivity and improve quality of work, showing good judgement about when to use them and the ability to explain the reasoning behind that use.

  • Guide & Assist: Support new customers through their application journey, simplifying complex steps and finding the right financial solutions for their business goals.

  • Build Partnerships: Foster long-lasting, trust-based relationships with a portfolio of existing and new clients.

  • Champion the Customer: Our systems are always developing. Act as the internal "Voice of the Customer," sharing insights with our product and tech teams to help us innovate and stay ahead of the competition.

  • Strategic Growth: Use your understanding of business drivers to help clients maximise their potential while keeping them informed about new opportunities and product developments.

  • Collaborate: Work within an international, cross-functional team to improve our processes and help us scale our mission.

The most important things about you:

We are looking for a driven, communicative, empathetic professional who thrives in a collaborative environment. You might be the right fit if:

  • You are a People Person: You genuinely enjoy connecting with others and are motivated by seeing your clients succeed.

  • You Thrive in Fast-Paced Environments: You have proven experience managing a high volume of calls without losing your cool. You can multitask effectively while maintaining a high standard of service and a positive tone.

  • You are a Problem-Solver: You enjoy thinking creatively and "outside the box" to find solutions for your clients and improvements for the team.

  • You are Organised & Proactive: You take pride in managing your work independently while remaining a reliable and supportive team player.

  • You are Multilingual: You possess C1-level German communication skills (both written and spoken) and are comfortable collaborating in English within our diverse, international office.

The salary

We expect to pay from £34,000 - £42,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.
